  • You work independently: you find opportunities, prioritize them and get them done without waiting for someone to prepare the tasks

  • You are based in Berlin or ready to relocate, and can join us in the office at least four days per week

Bonus points:

  • Organic growth experience with an international self-serve subscription, creative tool or consumer SaaS product

  • Product-led free tools, useful programmatic SEO, or multilingual sites

  • You make music or video yourself, or know AI creation workflows well

Benefits

VSOPs & Profit Sharing. Bi-weekly team lunches, regular team events, an annual summer offsite, learning & development support, productivity tools, a one-time headphone budget, Deutschlandticket, and a €5,000 referral bonus.

jobs.title: Senior Product Designer UX/UI (m/w/d) – Conversational & Agentic AI
jobs.description:
Dein Impact

  • Du gestaltest für eine Zukunft, in der Menschen seltener Apps öffnen und der Agent sie dort erreicht, wo sie gerade sind: im Chat, per Messenger, Mail, Sprache oder Benachrichtigung. Gestaltet wird das Erlebnis über alle Kanäle, nicht über einzelne Screens.

  • Du gestaltest, wie Menschen eine agentische KI erleben, die sie durch ihr Arbeitsleben begleitet und dabei unterstützt, souverän über ihre Karriere zu entscheiden. Dazu gehört, dass sich ein System, das in ihrem Auftrag handelt, nachvollziehbar, vertrauenswürdig und leicht bedienbar anfühlt.

  • Du entscheidest mit, was wir bauen, nicht nur, wie es aussieht. Neue Fähigkeiten entwickelst du gemeinsam mit Product von der ersten Idee bis zum fertigen Konzept.

  • Du verantwortest den Bereich Design & UX und legst das Fundament für ein wachsendes Produkt: Prinzipien, Design System, Informationsarchitektur und eine Arbeitsweise, die mitwächst.

So arbeiten wir

Wir bauen agentische KI nicht nur als Produkt, wir arbeiten auch selbst damit. In unserem agentengestützten Entwicklungsprozess wird aus Konzepten in kurzer Zeit lauffähiger Code, mit automatisierten Reviews und Tests in jeder Phase. Für dich heißt das: Zwischen deinem Entwurf und dem fertigen Feature liegen Tage, nicht Monate. Du arbeitest direkt mit Entwicklung und KI-Agenten zusammen, testest Ideen am echten Produkt statt am Klickdummy und entwickelst die Art, wie Design und Engineering bei uns zusammenarbeiten, aktiv weiter.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Produkt & Konzeption: Du übersetzt Nutzerbedürfnisse und Geschäftsziele in Produktkonzepte. Du entwickelst User Journeys, Story Maps und Feature-Konzepte und bringst sie mit Product, AI-Team und Engineering zur Entscheidungsreife.

  • Discovery & Research: Du planst und führst Nutzerinterviews, Usability-Tests und Konzeptvalidierungen durch. Du machst aus den Ergebnissen klare Empfehlungen für die Roadmap.

  • Kanalübergreifendes Erlebnis & Conversational Design: Du entwirfst, wie PAIDAI über Chat, Messenger, E-Mail, Sprache und Benachrichtigungen hinweg ein und dasselbe Gegenüber bleibt. Du entscheidest, welcher Kanal zu welchem Moment passt und wann der Agent von sich aus aktiv wird. In der App lässt du Chat, Formulare und strukturierte Ansichten zusammenspielen und übersetzt KI-Verhalten so, dass sichtbar wird, warum etwas vorgeschlagen wird, und nicht nur, was.

  • Mensch & KI im Zusammenspiel: Du gestaltest die Momente, in denen die KI an menschliche Expert:innen übergibt, so, dass für Nutzer:innen ein durchgängiges Erlebnis entsteht.

  • Design System & Informationsarchitektur: Du baust unser Design System in Figma auf und pflegst es, im Einklang mit der PAIDAI-Marke. Es reicht über grafische Oberflächen hinaus: Du legst fest, wie PAIDAI in Sprache und Text klingt, wie sich der Agent verhält und wie sich Nutzer:innen durch das Produkt bewegen.

  • Design im agentischen Workflow: Du sorgst dafür, dass Designentscheidungen sauber in unseren Entwicklungsprozess einfließen, etwa über klare Specs, Komponenten und Regeln, an denen sich Entwickler:innen und Agenten orientieren. Du reviewst, was gebaut wird.

  • Vertrauen & Compliance by Design: Du gestaltest Einwilligungs-, Datenfreigabe- und Transparenzmomente so, dass sie DSGVO und AI Act erfüllen, ohne Nutzer:innen auszubremsen.

Dein Profil

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung als UX/UI- oder Product Designer:in, davon einen relevanten Teil mit Verantwortung für Konzepte oder einen ganzen Produktbereich

  • Ein Portfolio, das deinen Weg vom Problem über das Konzept bis zum ausgelieferten Produkt zeigt, inklusive der Entscheidungen, die du unterwegs getroffen hast

  • Erfahrung in der Konzeptarbeit an der Schnittstelle zu Produktmanagement, z. B. mit Story Mapping, Priorisierung oder Hypothesen-Validierung

  • Du denkst über einzelne Screens hinaus und gestaltest Abläufe über mehrere Kanäle und Zeitpunkte hinweg

  • Sicherer Umgang mit Figma, Design Systems und komponentenbasiertem Arbeiten

  • Neugier auf KI-getriebene Produkte und darauf, selbst mit KI-Agenten zu arbeiten

  • Erfahrung mit Conversational, Voice oder Multichannel Design ist ein Plus

  • Du arbeitest eigenständig, vertrittst deine Konzepte überzeugend und arbeitest gern eng mit Engineering zusammen

  • Sehr gutes Deutsch in Wort und Schrift (mindestens C1)

Was wir bieten

  • Sinnstiftende Arbeit: Du baust ein Produkt, das Menschen im Arbeitsleben stärkt, vom Vertragscheck bis zur nächsten Karriereentscheidung. Was du gestaltest, macht für echte Menschen einen Unterschied.

  • Innovation: Agentische KI im Produkt und im eigenen Entwicklungsprozess. Bei uns arbeitest du mit Methoden, die anderswo noch Zukunftsmusik sind.

  • Federführend gestalten: Du prägst Produkt und Design eines jungen KI-Startups von Anfang an und baust den Bereich Design & UX selbst auf.

  • Eigenverantwortung: Du triffst wegweisende Entscheidungen, eigenständig und im Team.

  • Flexibilität: Hybrid, drei Tage pro Woche bei uns im Büro mitten in Hamburg

  • Teamgeist: Ein interdisziplinäres, motiviertes Team

  • Weiterlernen: Regelmäßiges Mentoring und fachliche Unterstützung

Du erfüllst nicht jeden Punkt? Bewirb dich trotzdem. Uns ist wichtiger, wie du denkst und arbeitest, als jedes Häkchen auf einer Liste. Wir freuen uns über Bewerbungen von Menschen aller Geschlechter, Hintergründe und Lebenswege.

jobs.title: Events & Community Manager
jobs.description:
About us:

Tebi is creating the first Connected Restaurant Management System that makes hospitality flow. In one seamless platform, Tebi embeds sales, reservations, kitchen prep, payments, and all the data that powers it, creating smooth service and intuitive insights.

Founded by Arnout Schuijff, co-founder of Adyen, and backed by €50 million in funding from Index Ventures & CapitalG, Tebi is built in service of hospitality first. Thousands of restaurants, cafés, bars, and coffee shops across the Netherlands, UK, Italy, Spain, Germany, Denmark and Finland already love running on Tebi.

About the role:

Restaurant owners trust other restaurant owners. They listen to the chef down the street, their wine supplier and their accountant long before they listen to an ad. That's why our events work. When we launched in Berlin, we hosted a four-hands dinner with two local merchants and a well-known food creator. We believe that’s what builds credibility, trust, and ultimately a warm prospect list.

We’re hiring an Events & Community Manager to turn that into a program that runs in several markets at the same time. You’ll plan and run our partner and owned events, and find new ways to grow Tebi through the hospitality community in each city, neighbourhood and market. You’ll work closely with our local sales teams so every event and partnership turns into real conversations.

This is a hands-on role. One week you'll be hosting a merchant dinner in Milan, the next you'll be setting up a distributor breakfast in Amsterdam. You'll report to the Head of Marketing and work closely with our Marketing team to extend these programs to our channel ecosystem, plus align closely with the General Managers and Account Managers in each market.

What you'll be doing:

  • Run events across markets: Plan and deliver partner and owned events in 2–3 markets at a time, from intimate merchant dinners and industry breakfasts to city launches. You own the calendar, budget, venues, suppliers, guest lists and the plan for the night.

  • Build the playbook as you go: Turn each event into templates, checklists and supplier lists, so we can launch a city campaign in weeks, not months. Improve them after every event.

  • Build local partner networks: Find the people operators already trust: drinks distributors, wholesalers, food creators, hospitality associations, accountants and the advisers who help new venues open. Build partnerships that bring us introductions and referrals, not just logos.

  • Put our merchants front and center: Work with our best merchants as hosts and anchors, so prospects hear about Tebi from the people they respect.

  • Turn connections into pipeline: Agree with local Sales and Account Management who to involve, how to follow up and who owns what conversations. Track every event in HubSpot from invite to demo to signed merchant.

  • Grow Tebi through the community: Find new ways to reach operators through the people and places they already trust, in each city, neighborhood and across borders. Keep guests and partners engaged after events, so one introduction leads to the next.

  • Open new community channels: Test new ways to grow through our close-knit industry, such as an affiliate or referral program for partners, sharing useful insights from our merchants, and showing up in the forums and groups where operators talk shop.

  • Capture the stories: Work with our creative team and relevant freelancers to turn events and partner moments into social content, case studies and sales material.

How we'll measure success:

  • Events delivered each quarter across markets, on time and on budget

  • Demos, pipeline and new merchants from each event and partnership

  • Introductions, referrals and leads from partners, affiliates and community channels

  • Cost per demo compared with our other channels

What you’ll bring:

  • Have built something people show up for: an event series, a supper club, a community, a program. You can point to what it led to, not just how many people came

  • Feel at home in hospitality. You've worked in or around restaurants, bars or food and drink brands, and you're comfortable leading a room full of operators

  • Are high agency. You own your calendar, your relationships and your results, and you don't wait to be told what to do

  • Build your own playbook when there isn't one, and you enjoy doing the work as much as planning it

  • Know the difference between a real community and a guest list

  • See growth opportunities beyond events, and are curious enough to test them

  • Can run several markets at once without dropping details, and are happy to travel regularly

  • Track what you do: comfortable with a CRM (HubSpot a plus), UTMs and simple reporting

  • Speak fluent English. Dutch, German, Italian, Spanish or a Nordic language is a plus

Typically this means 3–5 years in events, community, field marketing or partnerships, but we care more about what you've built than how long you've been doing it.

This role isn't for you if:

  • You'd rather plan the program than run it

  • You need a fixed playbook and a clear org chart to get going

  • You're not willing to roll up your sleeves on the night

Benefits:

  • Start-up Equity

  • Competitive Salary

  • Lunch Provided in Office

  • Team building events

  • Unlimited time off

What is Restaurant Software?

Restaurants and other merchants use various software systems such as Point of Sale (POS), Reservations, Kitchen Display Systems (KDS), Payments, Inventory, Staffing, and the list goes on. These systems all need to speak to each other which they frequently don’t. It’s a mess, and we are fixing it.

From buying a croissant at a cafe to having dinner with friends, it’s a €4 Trillion+ global market and a critical part of everyday life in today's economy.

How we use AI at Tebi

We use AI the way our merchants use Tebi, to cut out the friction and get to what matters faster. We believe in a world where AI increases quality, efficiency and speed.

At Tebi, AI isn't a policy or a checkbox, it's just part of how we work. It helps us write, analyse, build, and improve but doesn’t make the last call. If there's a smarter way to do something, we want to find it.

jobs.title: Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer
jobs.description:
Here at The Exploration Company, we are building spacecrafts for humanity.

About The Exploration Company

At The Exploration Company, we are developing, producing and operating Nyx, a modular and reusable orbital space vehicle that aims to eventually be refuelled in orbit, carrying cargo and potentially humans in the long run. The heart of a spacecraft lies in its engine, which is why we develop our own propulsion systems, aiming for the highest level of efficiency and reliability.

Role Summary

We are seeking a Junior Engine Control System & Monitoring Engineer to join the engine control and monitoring team of Storm, our high-thrust LOX/LCH4 cryogenic rocket engine. Working alongside senior control engineers, you will develop and test control and monitoring algorithms, work with the engine functional models provided by the functional team, contribute to setting up the controller development environment, and help verify the controller through Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop testing and during engine test campaigns. This is an entry-level, hands-on role for a recent graduate with strong control fundamentals who wants to learn on real hardware and progressively grow into full ownership of safety-critical engine control functions.

Key responsibilities:

1. Control & Monitoring Algorithm Development

• Design and implement engine control and monitoring algorithms, following the software team's rules, guidelines and auto-coding practices.

• Contribute to the definition of the engine regulation strategy (thrust and mixture ratio control, chill-down, start-up and shutdown transients) together with functional and system engineers.

• Support the definition of control and monitoring requirements for engine subsystems (valves, pumps, sensors, controller, software).

2. Simulation & Controller Development Environment

• Contribute to setting up the controller development environment: toolchain, model and code configuration management, auto-coding chain, and the MiL/SiL/HiL simulation and test infrastructure.

• Integrate the engine functional models delivered by the functional team (turbopumps, valves, combustion devices, cryogenic feed lines; steady-state, transient and chill-down) into the control design and simulation environment, deriving simplified or linearised models for controller synthesis where needed.

• Run closed-loop simulations to assess controller performance, stability margins and robustness to model uncertainties.

• Feed test results back to the functional team to support model correlation, and flag model limitations that matter for control.

3. Health Monitoring & Fault Management

• Contribute to the engine monitoring strategy that assesses the health status of the engine and its subsystems (combustion chamber, turbopumps, valves…).

• Implement fault detection and sensor validation logic for both real-time protection and post-test analysis.

• Support failure mode analyses (FMEA) and the management of failure modes, paving the way for engine reusability.

4. Validation, Testing & Documentation

• Prepare and run Model-, Software- and Hardware-in-the-Loop (MiL, SiL, HiL) test campaigns to verify the control and monitoring functions at each step, from Simulink model to embedded code on target hardware.

• Support Storm engine and component cryogenic (LOX/LCH4) test campaigns: test preparation, on-site support, data processing and post-test analysis.

• Produce clear development documentation: specifications, test procedures, test reports and justification files.

What we would love to see from you:

• Master's degree (or equivalent) in Aerospace, Electrical, Control or Mechanical Engineering, or a related technical discipline.

• Recent graduate (or graduating within the next months); no professional experience required. A master's thesis, internship or academic project in control, propulsion or embedded systems is a strong plus.

• Solid fundamentals in control theory, both classical and modern (state-space, robustness, digital control).

• Practical use of MATLAB/Simulink and Python through coursework or projects; basic knowledge of C/C++.

• Basic understanding of fluid dynamics and thermodynamics, and a strong interest in cryogenic propulsion and turbomachinery.

• Fluent in English.

Nice to Have:

• Exposure to MiL/SiL/HiL testing or real-time embedded systems.

• Experience with auto-coding from Simulink models.

• Familiarity with safety-critical design practices, reliability engineering or failure mode analysis.

• Interest or experience in data science applied to health monitoring and anomaly detection.

• Knowledge of space standards (ECSS, MIL-STD, NASA-HBK…).

• German and/or French.

Skills & Behaviours:

• Eagerness to learn and to take on increasing ownership under the guidance of senior engineers.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, including the ability to draw useful conclusions from partial or contradictory data.

• Clear oral and written communication; comfortable working closely with engine, avionics, software and test teams.

• Organised, able to prioritise tasks and deliver within time constraints.

• Positive, flexible attitude and enthusiasm for space exploration.

• Behaviour consistent with The Exploration Company's core values of Mission, Vision, Integrity, Excellence and Teamwork.

Why you should join us!

What makes us special here at The Exploration Company and why we think you will enjoy working here is:  

  • We’re Agile - we make decisions fast whilst keeping our goals and systems in mind 

  • We’re Open and Collaborative - we are transparent about risks and obstacles, so that we can cooperate to overcome them  

  • We have a lot of Fun - we refuel our energy knowing we are democratising space. It’s a wonderful and rare opportunity, are YOU up for the challenge?

STRUCTURAL DESIGN & ANALYSIS

  • Design and analyze the primary and secondary composite structures of our interceptor airframes (fuselage, wings/control surfaces, internal load-bearing components)

  • Define and document load paths, free-body diagrams, and failure modes for all major structural elements

  • Own composite laminate design, layup schedules, and bonding/joining strategies for carbon fiber structures

WEIGHT & PERFORMANCE OPTIMIZATION

  • Aggressively optimize structural weight without compromising strength, given the platform's speed and maneuverability requirements

  • Work with Aerodynamics and Propulsion teams to balance structural mass, CG, and vibration constraints against flight performance targets

  • Evaluate design trade-offs between composite and metallic/CNC solutions where each makes sense

TESTING & VALIDATION

  • Support structural, vibration, shock, and environmental qualification testing of airframe components and subassemblies

  • Analyze test and flight data to identify failure modes, including:

    • Fatigue and fracture

    • CG shifts

    • Vibration-induced damage

  • Support fast structural repairs and troubleshooting during flight test campaigns

MANUFACTURABILITY & PRODUCTION

  • Work directly with manufacturing partners and internal fabrication teams to ensure designs are manufacturable, repeatable, and cost-effective at scale

  • Get hands-on with composite fabrication and bonding to understand how parts are actually built, not just how they're modeled

  • Support the transition of airframe structures from prototype to serial production

CROSS-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION

  • Communicate structural decisions and analysis clearly to non-structural stakeholders

  • Contribute to design reviews and structural documentation standards as the team scales

CANDIDATE PROFILE

  • Demonstrated experience analysing and sizing airframe structures for aerodynamic, manoeuvre, propulsion, and inertial loads, with the ability to interpret, validate, and apply aircraft aerodynamic load cases

  • Proficiency in finite element analysis (FEA) for static strength, stiffness, buckling and vibration modelling

  • Familiarity with UAV/drone specific integration challenges, including payloads, batteries, avionics, propulsion mounting, and practical field repairability, would be a strong advantage

  • Experience designing lightweight carbon-fibre composite structures, including laminate design and sandwich panels and knowledge of composite manufacturing methods and processes

  • Experience designing parts for polymer 3D printed components, with a practical understanding of print orientation and load paths

  • Ability to perform hand calculations and correlate analytical results with FEA and structural test data

  • Strong communication and multidisciplinary collaboration skills across aerodynamics, systems and manufacturing teams

  • Experience with aeroelasticity analysis, including flutter, divergence, structural deflection, and vibration assessment, would be a strong advantage

jobs.title: MLOps Engineer
jobs.description:
About Alta Ares


Alta Ares is an air defense Neoprime. We build AI-guided interceptors to counter drones and cruise missiles, along with the software platform that powers them.

Our customers are NATO-aligned militaries and defense institutions, and our systems are regularly deployed during live exercises and operational demonstrations across Europe, the Middle East, and Asia.

Founded in 2024, we have grown to 90 people, raised over $60M, and increased revenue 40× this year. We are now entering a new phase of international expansion, industrial scaling, fundraising, and product development.

Role & Mission

As an MLOps Engineer, you will own the evolution of Gamma Ulixes, the AI product platform powering both our internal development workflows and customer-facing AI capabilities.

You will work alongside Machine Learning Engineers, Software Engineers and DevOps Engineers to transform research prototypes into production-ready AI systems.

Beyond infrastructure, you will help shape the tooling, services and workflows that accelerate the entire machine learning lifecycle, from data ingestion to deployment on operational platforms.

This role is ideal for engineers who enjoy building products, automating complex workflows and enabling AI systems to scale reliably.

Your Responsibilities

Gamma Ulixes AI Platform

  • Develop and improve Gamma Ulixes, our AI platform for training, evaluating and deploying machine learning models.

  • Build experiment tracking, model registry and dataset management capabilities.

  • Design reproducible ML workflows and automated training pipelines.

  • Develop benchmarking, evaluation and model validation services.

ML Infrastructure

  • Design scalable infrastructure supporting computer vision and trajectory-based machine learning.

  • Build APIs and backend services powering AI workflows.

  • Manage GPU infrastructure, distributed training and resource orchestration.

  • Improve monitoring, observability and reliability across AI services.

  • Maintain reproducible development and deployment environments.

Deployment & Edge AI

  • Build CI/CD pipelines for machine learning models.

  • Deploy AI services across cloud, on-premise and edge environments.

  • Optimize inference pipelines for Nvidia Jetson and embedded hardware.

  • Manage model packaging, versioning and rollout strategies.

  • Improve deployment reliability across operational environments.

Collaboration

  • Work closely with Machine Learning Engineers to industrialize research workflows.

  • Collaborate with Software Engineers to integrate AI capabilities into operational products.

  • Help define engineering standards, tooling and best practices across the Data & AI team.

  • Contribute to the evolution of Alta Ares' AI platform roadmap.

Requirements

Candidate Profile

  • 3–5+ years of experience as an MLOps Engineer, ML Platform Engineer, Software Engineer or Data Engineer working on production machine learning systems.

  • Strong Python software engineering skills.

  • Experience designing and operating production-grade ML infrastructure.

  • Solid understanding of Docker, Linux and containerized environments.

  • Experience with ML experiment tracking, model registries and reproducible workflows.

  • Experience designing APIs and backend services supporting AI applications.

  • Familiarity with CI/CD, infrastructure automation and cloud-native development.

  • Strong ownership mindset with the ability to drive projects from design to production.

  • Comfortable collaborating across Machine Learning, Software and Infrastructure teams.

Skills & Values

Product Ownership

  • Build products, not just infrastructure.

  • Focus on developer experience and operational excellence.

  • Deliver solutions that scale across teams and customers.

Platform Engineering

  • Design reliable, maintainable and observable AI systems.

  • Automate repetitive workflows.

  • Continuously improve engineering productivity.

Execution & Autonomy

  • Comfortable taking ownership of complex technical projects.

  • Pragmatic, impact-driven and hands-on.

  • Thrive in fast-moving environments with high technical standards.

Collaboration

  • Work effectively across AI, Software and Infrastructure teams.

  • Communicate clearly and document engineering decisions.

  • Contribute to a strong engineering culture built around quality and continuous improvement.

jobs.description:
Worum geht's?

Du hast bei KPMG, BCG, McKinsey, Bain oder einer vergleichbaren Beratung gelernt, wie man auf Vorstandsebene überzeugt, komplexe Transformationen strukturiert und unter Druck liefert.

Und du hast gemerkt: Die Decks werden größer, die Hierarchien länger, dein Impact auf die eigentliche Entscheidung wird kleiner. Up-or-out, 60-Stunden-Wochen für die Marke eines anderen, drei Freigabeschleifen bevor du mit dem Mandanten überhaupt sprechen darfst.

Bei SC Ventures drehen wir das um: Du übernimmst eigene Mandate bei etablierten Unternehmen mit wachsender Komplexität und sprichst direkt mit der Geschäftsführung oder dem Vorstand. Keine Pyramide dazwischen. Keine drei Partner, die sich vorher abstimmen müssen.

Was du bei einer Big4/MBB-Beratung an Struktur, Methodik und Executive-Kommunikation gelernt hast, bringst du zu uns – und wirst gleichzeitig daran beteiligt, was du aufbaust: Sobald deine Bestandskunden verlängern, bekommst du eine vertraglich geregelte Umsatzbeteiligung. Kein Bonus-Pool, keine Politik – dein Ergebnis, deine Beteiligung.

Wir sind kein Konzern. Wir sind ein schnell wachsendes Team, das im Bildungssektor bereits über 100 Träger jährlich betreut – Mandate, die von etablierten Bildungsträgern mit mehreren Standorten über wachsende Mittelständler bis hin zu Konzernmandaten reichen. Du gestaltest mit, wie dieser Bereich strukturiert wird, nicht nur, wie er ausgeführt wird.

Aufgaben

Was dich erwartet:

  • Du verantwortest eigenständig Beratungsmandate für Unternehmen mit wachsender Größe und Komplexität – von der Ansprache auf Geschäftsführungs-/Vorstandsebene bis zur Umsetzungssteuerung
  • Du entwickelst Geschäfts- und Betriebsmodelle für Vertriebs- und CRM-Transformation und verantwortest deren Umsetzung – nicht nur die Folie dazu
  • Du führst Strategie-Workshops und Steering-Committees auf C-Level-Niveau
  • Du baust gemeinsam mit der Geschäftsführung die methodische Basis für den Enterprise-Bereich mit auf: Angebotsstruktur, Delivery-Standards, Qualitätssicherung
  • Du bist Sparringspartner der Geschäftsführung bei der strategischen Weiterentwicklung von SC Ventures im Enterprise-Segment

Qualifikation

Was du mitbringst

  • Mehrjährige Erfahrung (ab Senior Consultant / Berater-Level) bei einer Top-Strategieberatung (MBB, Big4-Consulting o. ä.) oder vergleichbarer Inhouse-Strategiefunktion
  • Nachgewiesene Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Vorständen/Geschäftsführungen von Unternehmen relevanter Größenordnung
  • Fähigkeit, komplexe Transformationsprojekte eigenständig zu strukturieren und zu verantworten – ohne engmaschige Freigabeprozesse
  • Executive Presence: Du überzeugst auf Augenhöhe, ohne dich hinter einer großen Marke verstecken zu müssen
  • Unternehmerisches Denken: Du willst Verantwortung und Beteiligung, nicht nur ein Gehalt
  • Branchenkenntnis Bildungssektor/AZAV von Vorteil, aber kein Muss – die Beratungslogik zählt mehr als die Sektor-Historie

Benefits

Was du davon hast:

  • Umsatzbeteiligung auf deine Bestandskunden – vertraglich geregelt, ohne Politik
  • Direkter Zugang zur Geschäftsführung – du gestaltest den Enterprise-Bereich mit, statt ihn nur auszuführen
  • Schnelle Entscheidungswege – keine drei Freigabeschleifen zwischen dir und dem Mandanten
  • Kein Up-or-out – dein Wert bemisst sich an Ergebnissen, nicht an Politik oder Tenure
  • Attraktives Fixum plus Beteiligungsmodell
  • Eigenes Weiterbildungsbudget und klare Perspektive Richtung Partner-Modell/Teamleitung
  • Moderner Arbeitsplatz im Herzen Hamburgs, MacBook & iPhone
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Gründern statt anonymer Konzernstruktur

Wen wir wirklich suchen

Du kommst aus der Top-Beratung und willst nicht mehr für die Marke eines anderen liefern. Du willst eigene Mandate, echte Beteiligung und Entscheidungen, die auch wirklich deine sind.

Wenn du lieber baust als verwaltest und lieber mit einem kleinen Team etwas Großes aufziehst, als in einem großen Team ein kleines Rädchen zu sein – dann bist du hier richtig.

jobs.title: Technico-commercial(e)
jobs.description:
SYMAVAL PRO est une entreprise spécialisée dans l'irrigation agricole et les équipements destinés aux serres. Elle accompagne les professionnels du monde agricole dans leurs projets en proposant des solutions adaptées à leurs besoins : systèmes d'arrosage, équipements d'irrigation, installations pour serres et matériel technique. L'entreprise assure également le montage, la mise en service, l'entretien et le dépannage des équipements afin de garantir leur bon fonctionnement et d'accompagner ses clients au quotidien.

Dans le cadre du développement de notre activité, nous recherchons un(e) Technico-commercial(e) pour renforcer notre équipe sur notre agence basé à LOIRE-AUTHION (49) et contribuer au développement de notre portefeuille clients.

Vos missions

Véritable interlocuteur(trice) de nos clients, vous alliez compétences commerciales et intérêt pour la technique afin de proposer des solutions d'irrigation adaptées aux besoins de chacun.

Vos principales missions seront de :

  • Développer votre portefeuille clients et prospecter de nouveaux clients sur votre secteur ;

  • Identifier les besoins des exploitants agricoles et leur proposer des solutions adaptées ;

jobs.title: Working Student - LLM Quantization & Inference Performance
jobs.description:
About Tensordyne (formerly Recogni)

AI is transforming our world. It can perform cognitive functions that previously only humans could do, such as perceiving interactions across different modalities and environments - with the ability to quickly learn and then solve complex problems. Tensordyne is an AI system solution company that builds very high-performance, low-power generative AI inference systems. Our mission, through the creation of custom silicon, hardware and software, is to enable multimodal Generative AI inference acceleration at scale, with safe, sustainable, high-performance systems for our hyperscaler and neocloud data center customers. We are at the leading edge of advancing the latest research and product improvements for generative Al inference solutions that will make Al even more advantageous for compelling new generative AI applications.Tensordyne is a well funded, fast-paced startup company with headquarters in both Sunnyvale, CA, and Munich, Germany. We also have many talented team members working remotely across North America and Europe. We take care of our people and their families with comprehensive benefits, competitive compensation, flexible spending options, and recognition programs, because building category-defining technology starts with a healthy, supported team. Come join us as we shape the future of multimodal generative artificial intelligence!

Role summary

How much numerical precision does an LLM need, and where in the model architecture does it matter most? When does quantization improve runtime, and what does it cost in model quality?

We're looking for a motivated working student to help turn these questions into experiments and experiments into maintainable code. You'll explore optimization methods and build reusable evaluation tooling. You'll work closely with our quantization, compiler, and runtime engineers, and your findings will directly influence how we optimize models for Tensordyne hardware.

What you will do

  • Model quality evaluation: Measure how low-precision computation affects performance on coding and reasoning benchmarks. Diagnose where quantization has the greatest impact.
  • Quantization research: Implement and compare post-training quantization methods to improve inference efficiency while preserving task accuracy.
  • Build reproducible tooling: Automate evaluations, track configurations and results, and make experiments accessible to engineers and AI agents.
  • Measure runtime performance: Characterize latency, throughput, and memory usage to understand bottlenecks under different deployment scenarios.

A first project could involve exploring the quality–performance Pareto frontier of a Qwen or LlaMa model. You'll experiment with 16-bit, 8-bit, and 4-bit quantization configurations to find the best runtime-quality tradeoff.

Core qualifications

  • Current enrollment in Computer Science, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, or a related master's degree program.
  • Strong Python and PyTorch skills, including the ability to understand and modify model implementations.
  • Effective use of AI coding tools and critical review of their output.
  • An experimental mindset: you can formulate hypotheses, design comparisons, and draw careful conclusions from noisy results.
  • Clear communication and the ability to present experimental findings and technical tradeoffs to the team.

Strong pluses: experience with quantization, LLM evaluation, performance profiling, or inference optimization.

This role is for you if you thrive on responsibility, learn quickly, and are naturally proactive.

What we offer

Join a deep-tech team building the next generation of AI inference systems. Put your university knowledge into practice with leading open-source LLMs, deepen your understanding of quantization and inference optimization, and build skills in experimental design, software engineering, and AI coding tools. You'll own a focused project, receive close mentorship from experienced engineers, and have room to explore ideas that shape our optimization methods.

Tensordyne's culture was built on the following values

  • Put people first. We only succeed when our people succeed.
  • Ethics and integrity always. Be open, honest, and respectful of everyone.
  • Think Big. Be ambitious and have audacious goals.
  • Aim for excellence. Quality and excellence count in everything we do.
  • Own it and get it done. Results matter!
  • Make each person better together than they would be as an individual.
  • Embrace each other's differences, and embrace that there will be differences.

Tensordyne is an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams are better equipped to solve complex problems and build exceptional technology. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to age, color, gender identity or expression, marital status, national origin, disability, protected veteran status, race, religion, pregnancy, sexual orientation, or any other characteristic protected by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances.

A note to recruitment agencies: Please do not contact Tensordyne employees or leaders regarding this role. We do not accept unsolicited agency resumes and are not responsible for fees associated with unsolicited submissions.

InMobi sucht eine/n leidenschaftliche/n, ambitionierte/n und ergebnisorientierte/n Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, der/die die Neukundengewinnung für das App Performance Solutions-Team von InMobi in der DACH-Region und dem gesamten EMEA-Markt vorantreibt. In dieser Rolle sind Sie verantwortlich für die Identifikation, Ansprache und den Abschluss hochwertiger Geschäftsmöglichkeiten mit einigen der größten Marken in Nicht-Gaming-Verticals.

Sie werden Teil eines leistungsstarken Teams aus EMEA-Vertrieb, Client Growth und Media Buying unter App Performance Solutions, das Sie in Ihrem Wachstum und Erfolg im InMobi-Ökosystem aktiv unterstützt. Diese Stelle richtet sich an echte Hunter – Menschen, die Pipeline aus dem Nichts aufbauen, Türen öffnen, die andere nicht öffnen können, und aus kalten Erstkontakten langfristige Umsatzpartnerschaften entwickeln.

Diese Stelle ist eine vollständig remote ausgeübte Position mit Sitz in Deutschland. Fließende Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch sind erforderlich. Gelegentliche Reisetätigkeit für Kundenmeetings, Branchenveranstaltungen und persönliche Team-Meetings wird erwartet.

  • Identifikation, Akquise, Beratung und Entwicklung neuer Beziehungen zu strategisch relevanten Marken, Agenturen und Partnern zur Sicherung des langfristigen Wachstums der App Performance Solutions von InMobi
  • Nutzung Ihrer Marktkenntnis und der einzigartigen Wettbewerbsvorteile von InMobi zur Entwicklung neuer und nachhaltiger Geschäftsbeziehungen mit Werbetreibenden – einschließlich der Navigation in programmatischen und Walled-Garden-Ökosystemen
  • Pflege von Beziehungen zu Ökosystem-Influencern, MMPs, Agenturen und Partnern, um InMobi bei deren Kunden stets präsent zu halten
  • Verantwortung für den gesamten Sales Lifecycle – von der Outbound-Prospektion und Inbound-Lead-Qualifizierung über die Angebotserstellung, Nurturing und Aktivierung bis hin zur strategischen Wachstumsberatung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit funktionsübergreifenden Teams aus Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships und Product für ein reibungsloses Onboarding und die Übergabe an das Growth-Team
  • Repräsentation von InMobi App Performance Solutions bei wichtigen Branchenveranstaltungen, Konferenzen und Networking-Events in der gesamten EMEA-Region
  • Diszipliniertes Pipeline-Management unter Nutzung von CRM-Tools für präzise Prognosen und Performance-Tracking
  • Kontinuierliches Übertreffen der vierteljährlichen Umsatzziele durch strategische Neukundengewinnung und starkes Beziehungsmanagement

  • Advertising Technology Expertise. Sie haben mindestens 6+ Jahre Erfahrung im Ad Tech und kennen das EMEA-Ökosystem sehr gut. Erfahrung bei einem führenden Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP oder einem anderen Online-Werbunternehmen ist erforderlich.

  • Sprachen. Verhandlungssichere Kenntnisse in Deutsch und Englisch sind zwingend erforderlich.

Bei InMobi sind Sie umgeben von Menschen, die:

  • Groß denken und schnell handeln — wir sind unternehmerisch, gedeihen in Mehrdeutigkeit und lösen gerne wirkungsvolle Probleme
  • Leidenschaftlich sind und enormen Stolz auf ihre Arbeit legen — wir kümmern uns tief um die Wirkung, die wir erzielen
  • Ihre Ergebnisse verantworten — wir übernehmen Verantwortung, treffen mutige Entscheidungen und handeln mit Überzeugung
  • Freiheit mit Verantwortung verbinden — wir schätzen Autonomie und verstehen, dass Vertrauen mit Verantwortung einhergeht
  • An lebenslanges Lernen glauben — wir begrüßen Feedback, fordern uns selbst heraus und scheuen keine klugen Risiken

Unsere Vergütungsphilosophie ermöglicht es uns, wettbewerbsfähige Gehälter anzubieten, die Hochleistung fördern und gleichzeitig Geschäftsanforderungen sowie Lohngleichheit berücksichtigen. Das Grundgehalt oder die Festvergütung für diese Stelle liegt zwischen €132.500 und €167.250 (Minimum bis Maximum des Grundgehalts). Zusätzlich zum Grundgehalt können Sie variable Vergütung in Form eines jährlichen oder vierteljährlichen Leistungsbonus oder Sales Incentive erhalten, gemäß InMobi-Richtlinie.

Wir begrüßen Bewerbungen von allen qualifizierten Personen unabhängig von Rasse, ethnischer Herkunft, Geschlecht, Geschlechtsidentität oder -ausdruck, sexueller Orientierung, Religion oder Weltanschauung, Behinderung, Alter oder anderen durch geltendes Recht geschützten Merkmalen, einschließlich des Allgemeinen Gleichbehandlungsgesetzes (AGG).

Wie auch immer Sie sich identifizieren und welchen Hintergrund Sie mitbringen – wir laden Sie ein, sich zu bewerben, wenn diese Stelle Sie begeistert.

Ihre Daten werden für die Dauer des Bewerbungsverfahrens und gegebenenfalls darüber hinaus entsprechend den gesetzlichen Aufbewahrungspflichten gespeichert. Ihre Daten werden ohne Ihre ausdrückliche Zustimmung nicht an Dritte außerhalb des Bewerbungsverfahrens weitergegeben.

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword; it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences.

We thrive on challenges and seize every opportunity for growth. Our core values — thinking big, being passionate, showing accountability, and taking ownership with freedom — guide us in every decision we make.

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the Role:

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

The Impact You'll Make: 

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

  • Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions
  • Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies
  • Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team
  • Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth
  • Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking
  • Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

The Experience We Need: 

  • Industry experience. You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
  • An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.
  • A trusted advisor and consultant. You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.
  • A high-energy, passionate self-starter. You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.
  • Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller. You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.
  • A proactive problem solver. You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Eager, curious, and a fast learner. You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.
  • Education. A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
  • Language. Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. 

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who:

  • Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay equity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

Salary Range (Germany):

The base salary or fixed pay for this role ranges from €132,500 to €167,250 (min to max of base salary). In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible to receive variable compensation in the form of an annual or quarterly performance bonus or sales incentive, as determined per InMobi policy.

Note: Our ranges may vary based on final location and region of roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country. 

Benefits:

As an InMobi employee based in Germany, you will have access to our full EMEA benefits package. Detailed benefits information is available upon request and will be outlined in full during the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, including the German General Equal Treatment Act (Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz — AGG).

InMobi is proud to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace. If you require an accommodation, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword — it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

Data Privacy Notice (GDPR)

In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection law (Bundesdatenschutzgesetz — BDSG), InMobi collects and processes your personal data solely for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role.

Your data will be retained for the duration of the recruitment process and, where applicable, for a period thereafter in accordance with statutory retention obligations. Your data will not be shared with third parties outside of the recruitment process without your explicit consent.

You have the right to access, rectify, or request the deletion of your personal data at any time. To exercise your rights or for any data privacy enquiries, please contact: -----

By submitting your application, you confirm that you have read and understood this data privacy notice and consent to the processing of your personal data for recruitment purposes.

— DEUTSCHE FASSUNG —

jobs.title: Senior Sales Manager - EMEA
jobs.description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Overview of the Role:

InMobi is seeking a passionate, ambitious, and driven Senior Sales Manager to drive new logo activation for InMobi's App Performance Solutions team across the DACH region and broader EMEA market. In this role, you'll be responsible for identifying, engaging, and closing high-value opportunities with some of the largest brands across non-gaming verticals. This is a high-impact, quota-carrying role ideal for a self-starter who thrives in a fast-paced, data-driven environment and is passionate about helping performance marketers scale through programmatic app advertising.

You'll join a high-performing team spanning EMEA Sales, Client Growth, and Media Buying under App Performance Solutions — a team that will actively support your growth and success within the InMobi programmatic sales ecosystem. This is an exciting opportunity to make a visible impact across the EMEA region for a high-growth App Performance Solutions business comprising an AI/ML-driven DSP, Owned and Operated Glance TV, and Performance CTV.

This is a role for true hunters — those who thrive on building pipelines from scratch, opening doors others can't, and turning cold conversations into long-term revenue partnerships.

This is a fully remote role based in Germany. Proficiency in both German and English is required. Some travel is expected for client meetings, industry events, and in-person team sync-ups as needed.

The Impact You'll Make: 

As Senior Sales Manager, EMEA, you will be responsible for driving sales from a portfolio of Direct Brands and Performance Agencies across the DACH region by creating and selling effective App Performance Solutions. You will also actively participate in shaping InMobi's App Performance sales strategy, go-to-market approach, and execution plan across your key region within EMEA.

  • Identify, acquire, advise, and develop new relationships with targeted, strategic brands, agencies, and partners that ensure the growth and long-term success of InMobi's suite of App Performance Solutions
  • Leverage your knowledge of the market landscape and InMobi's unique selling propositions and differentiators to develop new and enduring business with advertisers — including navigating the Programmatic and walled garden ecosystems to position InMobi App Performance Solutions as a must-have for brands' app growth and retention strategies
  • Maintain strong relationships with ecosystem influencers, MMPs, agencies, and partners to keep InMobi top of mind for their clients
  • Own the entire sales lifecycle — from outbound prospecting and inbound lead qualification to proposal building, nurturing, activation, and strategic growth consulting
  • Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams across Client Growth, Media Buying, Legal, Finance, Ecosystem Partnerships, and Product to ensure seamless onboarding, execution, and account handover to the Growth team
  • Represent InMobi App Performance Solutions at key industry events, conferences, and networking opportunities across EMEA to drive visibility and pipeline growth
  • Maintain a disciplined approach to pipeline management, leveraging CRM tools for accurate forecasting and performance tracking
  • Consistently exceed quarterly revenue targets through strategic account acquisition and strong client relationship management

The Experience We Need: 

  • Industry experience. You bring 5+ years of hunting and selling experience to App businesses and Performance Agencies. You understand the challenges they face, can leverage your experience to develop compelling solutions, and have a track record of consistently meeting and exceeding revenue goals. You're known for building revenue where none existed — not just maintaining books of business, but creating them.
  • An advertising technology expert. You've spent at least 6+ years in ad tech and know the EMEA ecosystem well. Experience at a leading Performance DSP, Performance CTV, Ad Network, Rewarded Platform, MMP, or other online advertising company is required. You think deeply about clients' growth and retention challenges and know how to recommend the right solutions.
  • A trusted advisor and consultant. You have authentic communication skills and the ability to form consultative, credible, and long-standing relationships with your clients. In a marketplace flooded with vendors, your clients think of you first — not because you sold them, but because you solved for them.
  • A high-energy, passionate self-starter. You are highly self-motivated by nature, ambition is in your DNA, and you are extremely comfortable in a fast-paced, risk-taking, and often ambiguous environment.
  • Analytically strong and a compelling storyteller. You have strong analytical skills and the ability to peel back layers and find hidden opportunities. You don't just present numbers — you build narratives around them that move clients to action.
  • A proactive problem solver. You have a proven ability to solve customer pain points and technical challenges while proactively creating solutions through cross-functional collaboration.
  • Eager, curious, and a fast learner. You are naturally inquisitive, take a proactive approach, and seek out ways to support your colleagues. The ad tech landscape shifts constantly — signal loss, AI disruption, shifting buyer behaviour — and you lean in rather than wait for the dust to settle.
  • Education. A BA/BS degree in a relevant discipline is required, or equivalent professional experience. An MBA or Master's degree is a plus.
  • Language. Full professional proficiency in both German and English is required. 

At InMobi, you'll be surrounded by people who:

  • Think big and act fast — we're entrepreneurial, thrive in ambiguity, and love solving high-impact problems
  • Are passionate, fanatically driven, and take immense pride in their work — we care deeply about the impact we create and continuously push our potential
  • Own their outcomes — we take responsibility, make bold decisions, and execute with confidence
  • Embrace freedom with accountability — we value autonomy and understand that trust comes with responsibility
  • Believe in lifelong learning — we welcome feedback, challenge ourselves to grow, and aren't afraid to take smart risks

Compensation & Benefits

Our compensation philosophy enables us to provide a competitive salary that drives high performance while balancing business needs and pay equity. We determine compensation based on a wide variety of factors, including role, nature of experience, skills, and location.

Salary Range (Germany):

The base salary or fixed pay for this role ranges from €132,500 to €167,250 (min to max of base salary). In addition to your base salary, you may be eligible to receive variable compensation in the form of an annual or quarterly performance bonus or sales incentive, as determined per InMobi policy.

Note: Our ranges may vary based on final location and region of roles in accordance with the geographical differentiation in pay scales in the country. 

Benefits:

As an InMobi employee based in Germany, you will have access to our full EMEA benefits package. Detailed benefits information is available upon request and will be outlined in full during the hiring process.

Equal Opportunity & Inclusion

InMobi is an equal opportunity employer committed to fostering a diverse, inclusive, and equitable workplace. We welcome applications from all qualified individuals regardless of race, ethnic origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, religion or belief, disability, age, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law, including the German General Equal Treatment Act (Allgemeines Gleichbehandlungsgesetz — AGG).

InMobi is proud to provide reasonable accommodations to qualified individuals with disabilities throughout the hiring process and in the workplace. If you require an accommodation, please let us know, and we will work with you to meet your needs.

At InMobi, culture isn't a buzzword — it's an ethos woven by every InMobian, reflecting our diverse backgrounds and experiences. Howsoever you identify, and whatever background you bring with you, we invite you to apply if this role excites you.

In accordance with the General Data Protection Regulation (GDPR) and applicable German data protection law (Bundesdatenschutzgesetz — BDSG), InMobi collects and processes your personal data solely for the purpose of evaluating your application for this role.

jobs.description:
CHEEX is a progressive platform for sexual entertainment and education, where people of all sexual orientations and identities can safely and freely enjoy inspiring content. This is a 12-month mandate: you’ll work directly with our CMO to build new growth engines for CHEEX. Your mission: spot untapped marketing and sales opportunities, turn them into MVPs at speed, and validate what actually works in the market yourself. We’re looking for someone with drive, curiousity, ambitious and wired to think outside the box, who turns rough ideas into experiments and experiments into results. You’ll play an active role in shaping our future growth here.

Tasks

  • You’ll identify, test, and validate new marketing and sales opportunities to grow our customer base.
  • You’ll take full operational ownership of strategic initiatives, from shaping and prioritizing them together with our CMO through to evaluating results.
  • You’ll build new acquisition channels and commercial initiatives from scratch and bring them to market.
  • You’ll use modern software and AI tools to spin up prototypes (MVPs) fast and cost-effectively, then test them directly in the market.
  • You confidently use modern AI tools (e.g. Claude, Gemini) to massively speed up research, analysis, automation, and MVP development.
  • You’ll act as an independent self-starter, taking ideas from 0 to 1 with minimal guidance, validating results, and deciding what's next.

jobs.title: Head of Product
jobs.description:
Head of Product (m/f/d) | Berlin | Full-Time

Location: Berlin, Germany (office first)
Start date: As soon as possible
Company: Venture-backed AI startup, early stage

About the Company

We’re a fast-growing AI company building agents for complex, high-stakes enterprise workflows in public procurement, one of Europe’s largest and least digitised markets. Our product takes on the slow, manual, document-heavy work behind public tenders. That saves businesses and the public sector a great deal of wasted time and money.

The Role

We’re hiring a Head of Product to own and scale our product function. This is a hands-on individual contributor role. You’ll be the most senior product person in the company and work directly with the founders and engineering team. You’ll personally drive discovery, prioritisation and delivery. As we grow, you’ll set up how the product function works: its processes, rituals and culture. When the time is right, you’ll hire the team around you.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap, setting direction alongside the founders, engineering and customers.
  • Lead core product initiatives end to end, from discovery and scoping through launch and iteration. You’ll ship AI products that enterprise customers rely on.
  • Stay close to the product: test, refine and pressure-test our agents, and understand how prompts, context and evaluations shape quality.
  • Spend real time with customers. Uncover requirements, turn noisy feedback into clear priorities and become a trusted partner to their business.
  • Build the product function. Define how we discover, prioritise, ship and measure, and lay the foundations for a future product team.
  • Work with GTM on positioning and join sales conversations where product insight wins deals.


Who You Are

  • 5+ years in product management or a closely related role (founder, early operator, consulting into product), with a strong record of shipping.
  • A startup operator at heart. You’ve done your best work at early-stage companies, ideally as one of the first product hires or as a founder. Experience only at large corporates won’t be the right fit for this role.
  • A strong all-rounder, as comfortable setting strategy as writing a detailed spec, debugging an edge case or jumping on a sales call.
  • Exceptional product sense and user empathy. You look past the surface of a feature request to find the root problem.
  • Technically curious. You don’t need a CS degree or coding skills, but you’re confident working with engineers and exploring what AI can and can’t do.
  • A clear communicator who uses both qualitative and quantitative reasoning to make and explain decisions.
  • Based in Berlin or ready to relocate.
  • Fluent in English and German (required for our customer base).
  • Nice to have: B2B or enterprise software experience (strongly preferred), hands-on work with AI/LLM products, or exposure to public sector or regulated markets.


You’ll Thrive If

  • You love building from 0 to 1. You don’t need a roadmap handed to you, and you enjoy creating structure where there is none.
  • You move fast and are energised by an intense, ambitious environment.
  • You have a “no task is too small” mindset and lead by doing.
  • You love being in the office and believe in-person collaboration drives speed.


What’s In It For You

  • Ownership from day one. You’ll define the product, with direct access to the founders and zero red tape.
  • A role that grows with you. As the company scales, so do your scope and your team.
  • Shared upside: top-of-market compensation and generous equity.
  • A mission that matters. You won’t be optimising ad clicks. You’ll be helping businesses and the public sector cut waste on a huge scale.


Our Process

  • Review: All applications reviewed within 5 days.
  • Intro call: 30 minutes on your background and motivations.
  • Product deep dive (remote): 1 hour on your product thinking and problem-solving.
  • On-site (half day): Work through a real product use case with the team, followed by 1:1s with Engineering and GTM.
  • Offer: A quick final decision and transparent feedback straight after the on-site.


How to Apply

Apply through this posting with:

  • Your CV
  • A few lines on what excites you about this role
  • Optional: links to products you’ve shipped

jobs.title: Mandatory Internship – Product Development Engineer (m/f/d)

About ecopals

ecopals is building the leading performance additive platform for asphalt and bitumen modification, engineered for regional, sovereign supply chains and backed by strong unit economics. Our current product line is built on high-performance polymers, with further additive categories in active development. In the last two years, we have scaled to active operations in more than 10 EU countries, while continuously expanding our product and technology platform.

As we enter our next growth phase, we are opening a mandatory internship position for Product Development Engineer (m/f/d). The role works closely with our R&D team on the identification, assessment and development of new products, formulations and production routes.

The role combines materials science and engineering with data analysis and modern AI-assisted technical workflows, with a strong emphasis on using these tools to accelerate development without compromising scientific rigor.

Tasks

In this internship, you will help turn early technical ideas into structured development programmes and support the evaluation of which product and process routes are worth pursuing.

Areas of responsibility

  • Product development research. Researching potential development routes for new products, formulations and processes based on scientific literature, technical documentation, experimental results and first-principles understanding.

  • Development-route assessment. Comparing materials, technologies, mechanisms and production concepts and identifying promising routes for further development.

  • Technical and economic feasibility. Preparing structured assessments and reports on technical feasibility, process requirements, raw materials, costs and potential economic viability.

  • Test programme development. Supporting the design of experimental programmes, including formulation matrices, variables, testing methods and evaluation criteria.

  • Experimental and laboratory support. Preparing material samples for internal testing, external laboratories and customers; assisting with the preparation and execution of in-house experimental setups; and supporting the documentation and evaluation of experimental results.

  • Laboratory coordination. Supporting the planning and coordination of testing activities with internal and external laboratories, suppliers and technical partners.

  • Data analysis. Processing and evaluating experimental data to identify trends, correlations, performance drivers and development priorities.

  • Technical data management. Building and maintaining structured databases for formulations, raw materials, test results, literature and development projects.

  • Programming, data analysis and AI-assisted workflows. Using Python and modern AI-assisted development tools, including AI agents, to clean, structure, analyse and visualize technical data; automate repetitive R&D tasks; support technical research; and build internal analytical workflows. A key part of the role is learning to use these tools effectively and responsibly, with proper validation, documentation and control of the resulting work.

  • Technical standards and regulations. Researching and analysing standards, specifications and regulatory requirements relevant to products under development and their potential applications.

  • Technical reporting. Preparing clear technical reports and decision documents that translate scientific, experimental and economic information into actionable development recommendations.

  • Independent development work. Taking ownership of defined development questions and following them from initial research through analysis and experimental validation.

Requirements

  • Currently completing a Master’s degree or comparable advanced university programme in Chemistry, Chemical Engineering, Materials Science, Materials Engineering, Process Engineering, Environmental Engineering, Civil Engineering or a related field.

  • Good foundations in chemistry, materials science, construction materials and/or industrial processes.

  • At least two years of relevant experience in one or more of the activities described above, gained through internships, research projects, student assistant positions, laboratory work, industrial projects or professional experience.

  • Strong analytical skills and confidence working with quantitative technical and experimental data.

  • Programming and data-analysis skills, preferably with Python or comparable tools. Previous experience with AI-assisted coding or AI agents is valuable but not required. More important is the ability and willingness to rapidly adopt these workflows and use them rigorously — understanding what the tools are doing, checking their outputs, identifying errors and ensuring that analyses remain technically sound and reproducible.

  • Ability to work systematically with scientific literature, experimental results and complex technical information.

  • Ability to move between fundamental scientific questions and practical engineering and production constraints.

  • A structured and independent way of working, with a strong sense of ownership.

  • Strong written and verbal communication skills in English; German is a plus.

  • An entrepreneurial and pragmatic mindset, with genuine interest in developing technologies that can move from research into industrial application.

Your Benefits

  • Direct involvement in product development, contributing to technologies that may become future ecopals products.

  • Exposure to the full development process, from scientific principles and formulation concepts to processes, testing and economic assessment.

  • Practical experimental experience, supporting material preparation, in-house experiments and laboratory validation activities.

  • Hands-on experience with technical data and analytical tools, including opportunities to improve how R&D data is structured, analysed and used for decision making.

Als Franchise Partner gewinnen Sie KMU-Inhaber (5-10 Klienten) als langfristige Mentoring-Mandate. Die Zusammenarbeit läuft über strukturierte KMU-Programme in drei Phasen:

  1. Discovery Session – Sie knüpfen eine Verbindung, verstehen die persönliche Motivation des Unternehmers, seine Hoffnungen und Herausforderungen.

  2. Profit Leakage Session – Mit dem thexton armstrong Online-Tool identifizieren Sie live, wo und wie viel Profit aus dem Unternehmen fließt. Sofortige, greifbare Erkenntnisse.

  3. Proposal Session – Gemeinsam planen Sie die Zusammenarbeit: welches Programm, welche Ziele, welche Schritte.

Klienten unterschreiben Verträge mit monatlicher Abrechnung – das schafft planbare, wiederkehrende Einnahmen für Sie und entlastet die Cashflow-Planung des Klienten.

Disputes sit at the intersection of merchant-facing products, complex scheme and regulatory processes, and data-driven decisioning. Our team owns the full stack, anchored by a .NET back end that manages the dispute lifecycle and integrates with card schemes, alongside the front-end experiences merchants use to track and respond to disputes and the machine learning models that predict outcomes and recommend the best action on every case.

We're building for scale, and that scale brings ambiguity, shifting priorities, and the occasional setback - so we're looking for a resilient leader who has built and sustained high-performing teams, learned from failure, and come back stronger. Above all, you'll be someone who drives predictable delivery and operational efficiency: shipping consistently, running systems reliably, and continuously improving how the team works. The ideal candidate has operated across both enterprise and scale-up environments and has a proven track record of driving growth within large, complex, regulated organisations.

  • Lead a team centred on a .NET back end, with front-end and machine learning components, helping engineers establish and validate their understanding of technical architecture and design end-user-centric systems and tools.

  • Own predictable, high-velocity delivery — establishing healthy engineering practices, sensible estimation, and a smooth path from idea to production so the team ships consistently and sustainably.

  • Drive operational efficiency and reliability by automating processes — including monitoring and alerting — meeting SLAs/SLOs, reducing operational cost, and minimising toil to keep the team focused on high-value work rather t

  • Build and strengthen relationships with engineers, managers, and people leads across multiple teams.

  • Operating in a highly regulated financial space, ensure compliance with a range of control frameworks — from internal stakeholders such as InfoSec and Internal

  • Audit, to external auditors, card schemes, and regulators.

  • Oversee the responsible use of machine learning and AI in dispute decisioning, leading the team to develop the infrastructure, tooling, and governance required to run models safely and at scale in production.

About You

  • A resilient leader who has learned from setbacks and failures and consistently comes back stronger, keeping teams steady and delivering through periods of change and ambiguity.

  • You thrive on pace. You're energised by a high-growth environment, comfortable making decisions with imperfect information, and you keep the team moving and shipping when priorities shift under you.

Comfortable also overseeing front-end and machine learning work, able to earn credibility and make sound trade-offs across disciplines even where you aren't the deepest expert.

  • Able to partner with Product Management to assess technical feasibility, provide capacity estimates, and balance new features against architectural health.

  • Excellent time management and proactive problem-solving skills.

Technologies we work with

  • Back end (primary): .NET / C#, REST APIs, event-driven and microservice architectures.

  • Front end: React, TypeScript.

  • Machine learning: Python, model training and serving, and the infrastructure to run models in production.

  • Data & platform: SQL, plus experience designing batch and stream data-processing systems.

  • Cloud & tooling: AWS and/or GCP, Docker, Terraform, and observability tooling such as Datadog.

  • Knowledge of Kubernetes, Kafka, and CI/CD pipelines is highly beneficial.
