jobs.title: Deployment Strategist
jobs.description:
About Atira

Atira builds the commercial brain for industrials. Our agents 10x the sales engineers of today by offering the complete toolbox of tasks needed in complex environments. They handle everything from extracting and classifying requirements from incoming RFQs, orchestrating communication and information retrieval across multiple stakeholders and systems, while generating outcomes like documentation, production system inputs, or configuration recommendations. CRM. Atira. ERP.

We are one of the fastest growing teams in Munich and are looking for you to join us!

Why Deployment Strategists are our customers' #1 go-to person

We aim to solve the most complex problems in sales engineering and work closely with customers in mapping out their ideal inbound process. You will dive into our enterprise customers processes to help deploy Atira agents with our FDEs and face their most intricate challenges. You are the go-to person inside our largest partners for anything project management and use case scoping related, and this from the point where you demo our product for the first time up until multi-annual partnership commercial negotiations.
Trust and use case insights are your two most valuable resources you get from customers and what you bring back home will directly shape our core platform in the near future - this requires a strong taste when it comes to how a software product is shaped and a strong opinion on what is needed to maximize customer satisfaction. Beyond that, our Deployment Strategists think beyond a single customer and are essential in figuring out the concrete steps to scale to our next 100 customers by accelerating onboarding processes and increasing customer satisfaction.

What you will do

  • Own the customer end-to-end together with an FDE Tech Lead. From kickoff to renewal, you are on the hook. You run SteerCos, scope deployments, drive onboarding, and decide what gets built next.

  • Scope the agents that work best for a customer You go deep on each customer's technical sales process, understanding it in all it’s details. You bring home whatever solves their problems and conceptualize this across all of your customers

  • Decide what scales and what doesn't. You sit at the boundary between customer work and the core platform. You translate customer behavior into product feedback features and will need to be opinionated on product / our agents

  • Identify, elevate and partner with end users as well as C-Level. You support the internal owner and help scope the long term growth plan.

  • Tell the story. You speak at industry events, co-author case studies, and represent Atira in front of customer executives and prospects. The GTM motion is built around the stories you create

What we are looking for

Ownership, drive, structured thinking, and the ability to thrive in ambiguity and open ended problems. You take problems personally, decide in the absence of a clear roadmap, and own the outcome including the downside.

Your profile

  • Demonstrated ownership and initiative: a company you started, a leading role in a team or larger project

  • 3+ Years customer facing experience working with both end users and C-Level

  • You thrive in customer-facing situations: high-stakes conversations with executives energize you, you push back when needed, and you walk out with a clear next step

  • You’ve optimized your AI tooling: you’ve invested heavily in building the skills and context layer to get the maximum out of your day

  • Relevant coding or strong analytical experience

  • Full working proficiency in both German and English

  • Frontend and app-building / Feature taste

  • Occasional on-site travel per customer requirements; 20-40% overall (DACH primarily, occasionally international)

What you'll get

  • Real ownership: you'll be one of the early team members and shape both product and comapny as well as work closely with customers

  • Strong peers: work with people who have built and shipped AI systems in industrial environments at scale before, and the chance to learn directly from them

  • Impactful work: your code is deployed all across Europe’s and US industrial backbone, affecting how complex products and services are sold and configured worldwide

  • Competitive salary & equity package and additional benefits including Wellpass, JobRad and company dinners

  • Most importantly: Collaborate & thrive in a high-performing but caring culture. We will own the industrial sales function but will do so with modesty and integrity

What success looks like after a few months

  • You independently run enterprise deployments end-to-end, from kickoff to production

  • Customers rely on you as their primary contact and trust your judgment

  • Your learnings have shaped core platform features and the playbook for the customers who come after you

jobs.title: Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
Your Role

We are looking for a Senior Data Engineer (f/m/d) at LIQID, who will play a pivotal role in building and scaling data infrastructure that powers decision-making.

You will design scalable, high-performance data pipelines, ensure data integrity, and drive efficient data processing across the organization. Working closely with our Head of Data, Analytics Engineers, and cross-functional teams, you will develop robust data architectures, enhance data security, and implement best practices that empower data-driven decision-making at scale.

This is not a role where you preserve what already exists. It is a role where you build what comes next. As LIQID scales beyond €4 billion in assets under management, the demands on our data infrastructure are growing fast. You will have real ownership over how we meet that challenge, with the autonomy to propose solutions and the backing to ship them.

 

What will keep you challenged?

  • Design, build, and optimize scalable data pipelines and storage solutions that ensure efficient, secure, and reliable data processing from source systems to our data warehouse

  • Develop and manage ETL/ELT workflows to integrate data from multiple sources, ensuring seamless ingestion, transformation, and availability

  • Implement and enforce data quality, validation, and monitoring processes to guarantee accuracy and integrity for analytics and operational use cases

  • Ensure data security and compliance by applying best practices and industry standards for handling sensitive information

  • Collaborate with analysts, product managers, and engineers to understand data needs and deliver solutions that unlock new insights

  • Continuously evaluate and integrate new technologies to improve scalability, performance, and future-proof LIQID’s data infrastructure


What you bring

  • Over 5 years of professional experience in data engineering, data architecture, or a similar data related role

  • Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Data Engineering, Information Systems, or a related field

  • Strong proficiency in SQL, Python and ETL/ELT frameworks, with experience in data modelling, warehousing, and database management (e.g., BigQuery, Snowflake, PostgreSQL)

  • Experience with cloud data platforms (e.g., AWS, Google Cloud) and modern data pipeline tools (e.g., Airflow, dbt)

  • Solid understanding of data modelling principles to meet data governance, security, and compliance best practices and ensure safe and scalable data operations

  • FinTech experience is a plus, but a strong interest in financial services and data-driven decision-making is essential

  • Experience using AI coding tools (Copilot, Cursor, Claude) to speed up development and integrating them into standard workflows (code review, CI/CD), with the judgment to verify output, not just ship it.

  • Experience with data quality testing frameworks or rules-as-code approaches (e.g. dbt tests, Great Expectations) to catch issues before they hit production.

  • Experience with streaming/near-real-time pipelines (Kafka, Kinesis, or similar) is a plus.

  • Fluent in English, both written and spoken; German is a plus


What we offer

jobs.title: Financial Controller (w/m/d)
jobs.description:
Tangany mit Sitz in München ist ein innovatives Technologieunternehmen mit einer marktführenden B2B-Lösung für die Verwahrung digitaler Vermögenswerte (z. B. Kryptowährungen, Stablecoins und anderen tokenisierten Vermögenswerten) in Blockchain-Netzwerken. Unsere Lösung wird bereits von mehr als 50 institutionellen Kunden eingesetzt. Als lizenziertes Finanzinstitut wird die Tangany GmbH von der BaFin reguliert.

Für unser anhaltendes Wachstum suchen wir einen Financial Controller (w/m/d) zur Verstärkung unseres Teams.

Deine Rolle

Du verantwortest das Controlling und die Finanzsteuerung und berichtest an das Management Board.

Das Team ist klein. Deine Expertise und dein Beitrag wirken sich unmittelbar aus: Du arbeitest mit unserer Accountant und unserer Steuerkanzlei z.B. an Themen wie Finanzbuchhaltung, Lohn und Umsatzsteuer-Voranmeldung; die formale Verantwortung für das Rechnungswesen liegt bei der Geschäftsleitung, Zahlungen geben wir im Vier-Augen-Prinzip frei. In diesem Rahmen bist du die Person, die weiß, wo die Zahlen stehen, warum sie dort stehen und wie sich Ergebnis, Kosten, Liquidität und Eigenmittel entwickeln werden.

Der Kern der Rolle hat zwei Seiten: die regulatorische Pflicht und eine Steuerung, mit der wir jede Finanzfrage jederzeit in wenigen Minuten beantworten können. Business Cases und Investor Reporting kommen dazu und wachsen mit dir.

Heute arbeiten wir vor allem mit DATEV Unternehmen Online und Tableau. Die Steuerung darauf baust du zu großen Teilen neu auf, gern AI-gestützt: Unser AI-Dev-Team setzt mit dir Live-Reporting, Abstimmungen und ein Finanz-Cockpit um.

Aufgaben

  • Den Jahresabschluss nach HGB und RechKredV erstellen, ergänzt um die RechZahlV-Posten für unser Zahlungsgeschäft, und die Prüfung gemeinsam mit unserer Steuerkanzlei und Abschlussprüfer durchführen.

  • Das aufsichtsrechtliche Meldewesen führen und Finanzinformationen nach gesetzlichen Vorgaben unter Begleitung des Compliance-Teams bereitstellen.

  • Regulatorische Planzahlen, etwa die Eigenmittelanforderung, aus der Bilanzplanung ableiten und in Abstimmung mit der Geschäftsleitung laufend überwachen.

  • Cashflow- und Runway-Planung führen und Finanzierungsbedarf früh sichtbar machen.

  • Liquiditäts- und Kontrahentenrisiken in das unternehmensweite Risikocontrolling einbringen und laufend überwachen.

  • Business Cases und Rentabilitätsrechnungen erstellen und Investor-Updates vorbereiten.

  • Eine Kostenstellenstruktur aufbauen, Budgets je Kostenstelle mit den Verantwortlichen festlegen, Kosten, Budgets und KPIs laufend überwachen sowie Live-Reporting und Ad-hoc-Auswertungen für Geschäftsleitung und Budgetverantwortliche bereitstellen und Plan-Ist-Abweichungen analysieren.

  • Aus der Praxiserfahrung heraus Input liefern, um Finanzprozesse, Tools und das interne Kontrollsystem gemeinsam mit unserem AI-Dev-Team auszubauen.

Wen wir suchen

  • Du bist Controller:in (idealerweise aus einem regulierten Institut) und hast Jahresabschluss und Meldewesen selbst verantwortet.

  • Abweichungen erkennst du früh: Wenn sich Eigenmittel, Liquidität oder Kosten in die falsche Richtung bewegen, liegt deine Analyse mit Optionen auf dem Tisch, solange noch Zeit zum Handeln ist.

  • Deine Forecasts halten auch Monate später, und wo sie abweichen, kannst du erklären, warum.

  • Meldefristen und Prüfungsanforderungen baust du so in die Abläufe ein, dass vor dem Stichtag keine Ad-hoc Aktion nötig ist.

  • Prüfer und Risikocontrolling nehmen deine Zahlen als Ausgangspunkt.

  • Stellt die Geschäftsleitung eine Finanzfrage, kannst du schnell und problemlos Antworten geben, weil deine Daten und Auswertungen genau dafür gebaut sind.

  • Du entscheidest auch mit unvollständigen Informationen, sagst klar, wenn etwas nicht geht, und stellst einen Prozess um, sobald er nicht mehr passt.

Qualifikation

Must-Haves

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium oder Ausbildung in Finanzen, Controlling oder einem verwandten Feld.

  • Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung im Controlling oder Rechnungswesen, idealerweise in einem regulierten Institut (nach KWG, ZAG oder MiCAR) oder in der Prüfung entsprechender Institute.

  • Eigenständig erstellte Jahresabschlüsse nach HGB, sowie Erfahrung mit Liquiditäts- und Kontrahentenrisiken sowie Risikotragfähigkeit.

  • Aufbau von Kostenstellenrechnung und Management-Reporting, sicherer Umgang mit DATEV, Excel und Google Sheets inklusive Finanzmodellen und deren Visualisierung, idealerweise mit einem BI-Tool wie Tableau.

  • Offenheit: Reporting mit AI-Werkzeugen neu aufsetzen.

  • Fließend Deutsch und Englisch (C1 oder höher).

Nice-to-Haves

  • Erfahrung mit MiCAR, etwa der Eigenmittelberechnung.

  • FP&A, Business Cases oder Investor-Reporting in einem wachsenden Unternehmen.

  • Erfahrung im aufsichtsrechtlichen Meldewesen nach KWG oder ZAG.

  • Interesse an Krypto und Tokenisierung.

Benefits

Flexibilität & Work-Life-Balance:

  • 30 Tage Urlaub, dazu jeweils ein halber Tag frei an Heiligabend und Silvester, und bei Bedarf zusätzlicher unbezahlter Urlaub, um die Akkus wieder aufzuladen.

  • Zusätzlicher bezahlter Urlaub für frischgebackene Eltern.

  • Die Freiheit, von zu Hause oder in unserem schönen Büro mitten in München zu arbeiten.

  • Möglichkeit einer Workation, um auch auf Reisen zu arbeiten.

  • Flexible Arbeitszeiten: Du arbeitest, wenn du am produktivsten bist.

Deine Entwicklung:

  • Es startet mit dem ersten Tag: Mit unserem auf deine Bedürfnisse zugeschnittenen Onboarding erhältst du einen strukturierten Einarbeitungsplan und Feedbackgespräche während der Probezeit (und natürlich auch danach).

  • Wir wachsen und möchten, dass du mit uns wächst! Werde zum Blockchain-Experten, tausche dich mit unserem hochmotivierten Team aus und bilde dich in individuellen Trainings weiter.

  • Regelmäßige Feedback-Gespräche: Zweimal im Jahr evaluieren wir gemeinsam mit deinen Karriereweg und leiten die nächsten Schritte in die richtige Richtung ein.

Entlohnung und Zusatzleistungen

  • Ein attraktives, marktkonformes Jahresgehalt.

  • Spaß bei der Arbeit: eine Runde mit Kolleg:innen an unserer Tischtennisplatte, ein Feierabendgetränk auf unserer großartigen Dachterrasse und unsere Team-Events.

Motivierte Mitarbeitende sind der Schlüssel zum Erfolg. Deshalb bieten wir dir über Hrmony flexible, digitale Benefits, die dich im Alltag unterstützen. Du erhältst ein monatliches Budget, das du nach deinen Bedürfnissen aufteilst:

  • Essenszuschuss: für Lebensmittel, Restaurants oder Lieferdienste

  • Mobilitätsbudget: z. B. für das Deutschlandticket

  • Sachbezüge: flexibel nutzbar für Streaming, Fitness, Shopping und mehr

Werde Teil unseres Teams und revolutioniere gemeinsam mit uns den traditionellen Finanzmarkt. Nutze die Chance und gestalte die Zukunft der Branche aktiv mit. Bewirb dich jetzt und sei Teil unserer innovativen Reise, um Blockchain-Technologie für jeden zugänglich zu machen.

jobs.title: Senior Level Designer
jobs.description:
Homa is a global mobile game developer and publisher creating games people love. We partner with studios and internally develop games, having launched over 80 titles, reached over 2 billion downloads, and seen our game All in Hole break into the global top-50 grossing charts. These are milestones, not the finish line.

With deep expertise in product and technology, we built Homa Lab, our proprietary platform that gives developers the market intelligence, data tools, and game tech, with AI built-in, to find product–market fit fast and scale mass-market games into lasting experiences players enjoy for years.

This is our flywheel: Homa Lab helps studios spot the right ideas early, turn them into games quickly, and reach millions of players. Every launch brings back data and insights that fuel the next hit, making each turn of the loop faster, smarter, and more likely to win. AI supercharges this process, running through everything we do, from everyday tasks to our guiding principles.

What powers the loop is talent density. 220+ people from 30+ nationalities, bringing expertise from the world’s best studios and companies. We uphold ambition, curiosity, humility, and focus, and deliver with speed, excellence, and candor.

Since the start, we’ve raised $165M from Headline, Northzone, Eurazeo, Bpifrance, and the founders of King, Sorare, and Spotify, people who’ve built and backed the games and platforms we admire, now supporting our drive to create the next ones.

At Homa, we are building the next billion-player experiences from the ground up and shaping the future of entertainment.

The opportunity

You’ll be the keeper of the player experience on our hybrid casual RPG. Combat, heroes, art, and features all come together in the levels you build, and you decide whether that adds up to something players want to come back to.

You’ll join a small, AI-native game team on its way to launch. You’ll own the level design area completely: you set the roadmap, make the calls, and ship. A dedicated level editor and an AI-powered level generation pipeline will be ready on day one, so you spend your time on what matters: making every level fun.

What you’ll do

  • Build. Design, build, and tune levels directly in Unity, covering layouts, encounters, pacing and difficulty.
  • Scale. Triple our level content by combining our AI pipeline with your own design judgment.
  • Balance. Model how health, damage, and stat changes affect the numbers before anything ships.
  • Polish. Bring existing levels to final quality and give them the feel and juice that make players stay.
  • Own. Set the level design roadmap, make design calls, and question whether each choice fits the game.
  • Specify. Write clear, detailed specs that developers can implement as written.
  • Learn from players. Use playtests and player data to see what works and iterate quickly.
  • AI. Use AI every day to generate layouts, prototype encounters, simulate balancing, and automate level work.

Requirements

  • Years of level design experience, with shipped levels on a hybrid casual, RPG or combat-based game.
  • Hands-on balancing skills: you’re comfortable with stats, health and damage maths, and spreadsheets.
  • Fluency in Unity: you build and iterate levels in the engine yourself.
  • A strong sense of game feel: you know when a level is fun, and you can explain why.
  • AI is already part of how you work every day. You've used it to automate, speed up, or rethink.
  • The autonomy to build your own roadmap and make design decisions.
  • A data-driven approach to level tuning.
  • Feature design experience alongside level design.

For this role, you’ll also bring

  • Extreme ownership. You drive outcomes. When something breaks, you fix it instead of explaining why it broke.
  • Proactive. You don’t wait for instructions or perfect conditions. You spot what needs doing and do it.
  • Pragmatism and simplicity. You look for the simplest solution that works, use whatever tools are available, and ship.
  • Sharp thinking. You learn fast, reason from facts, and structure your ideas clearly.
  • Hungry and motivated. You’re ambitious, high-energy, and grounded.

Even if you don’t check every box in our requirements, we encourage you to apply. We value diverse perspectives and backgrounds, and we’re more interested in your potential and passion than a perfect match to our checklist.

Why Homa

  • Exceptional growth. We hire people of outstanding potential, then put them where they can grow fastest.
  • Real ownership. You own the player experience of a game, and you’ll see your levels move the metrics.
  • The right tools from day one. A dedicated level editor and an AI level pipeline, so you focus on design.
  • A high talent bar. Our teams are small and ambiti us, and the people around you will push you to grow.
  • AI at the core. You’ll have access to the best AI tools, and you’ll help shape how level design works in an AI-first company.

Benefits

At Homa, we prioritize talent, energy, and determination over traditional credentials. We’re building a global community of brilliant, driven people who think boldly, act with pragmatism, move fast, and push boundaries. We believe true innovation comes from diverse perspectives, deep collaboration, and curiosity without limits. Our culture is grounded in four core values:

  • Humility: We recognise that we are always learning, we can always improve and grow.
  • Curiosity: We continuously seek the “why” behind the “what” - we explore with purpose and practicality.
  • Focus: Our curiosity takes us deeper, not wider - we obsess over the details and let pragmatism guide our attention.
  • Ambition: We strive for the best - we don’t settle for “good enough,” - we use common sense to reach higher.

Benefits

Building great games starts with building a great place to work. Here’s what you can expect:

  • 🏥 Comprehensive Benefits: Depending on your location, you’ll enjoy a range of perks such as insurance, meal vouchers, public transport, gym memberships, and more.
  • 🏢 Paris HQ Access: Enjoy a desk at our private office in a well-located WeWork building that will give you access to WeWork perks like rooftop view and designed coworking spaces.
  • 🌍 Coworking Access: You will have access to WeWork spaces throughout Europe, along with all their perks and professional office environments.
  • 🌐 Global Team: Collaborate in English with top-tier talent from 35+ countries, spanning Europe, the UK, the US, and more. Diversity fuels our creativity and innovation.
  • ✈️ Team Gatherings: We value time together beyond the screen. Join us for occasional team gatherings, off-site retreats (Workations as we name them) to connect, recharge, and celebrate.
  • 📈 Performance Reviews: We’re committed to your growth. Every six months, we reflect on your progress, recognize your achievements, and align on clear development goals.
  • 💻 Equipment Support: From day one, we’ll provide everything you need to do your best work, including a home office setup allowance if you're working remotely.

Where We Hire

Our HQ in Paris is a vibrant hub of creativity, collaboration, and connection. From rooftop lunches and coffee chats to after-work apéros and community events, we’ve designed a space people genuinely enjoy - all within a cozy WeWork filled with good energy (and snacks).

We also have incredible team members across Europe - from Spain and Turkey to Germany, North Macedonia, Poland, the UK, and more. Whether you’re working from a sunny WeWork in Barcelona or your home setup in Warsaw, you’re fully part of our culture. To keep collaboration smooth, we primarily hire within European time zones (UTC to UTC+3). If you're based there - or planning to be - we’d love to hear from you!

Please note: this is one remote position open to multiple countries, not multiple openings.

  • Hands-on social media experience, especially on LinkedIn; familiarity with design tools (e.g. Canva, Figma) and video tools.

  • Obsessed with execution: driven to achieve goals

  • Attention to detail and excellent organizational skills

  • Willingness to travel regularly for events

What we offer

  • A skilled and experienced team, including world-renowned experts

  • A great moment to join as the company grows and expands

  • State-of-the-art technology and IT infrastructure

  • Hybrid remote work and flexible working hours

  • Fun team events

  • RTT based on Syntec classification

Closing

As the company evolves in a dynamic and innovative environment, its DNA is based on merit. As such, there will be significant growth opportunities for candidates with an open and deliver mindset. We are an equal opportunity employer.

We will not consider applications via agencies.

jobs.description:
Bildung verändert Leben.

Wir bei Kufer sorgen dafür, dass unsere Kunden den Kopf frei haben für das, was wirklich zählt. Unsere Software unterstützt Bildungseinrichtungen dabei, ihre Arbeit einfacher, strukturierter und menschlicher zu gestalten. Dafür brauchen wir Menschen, die mitdenken, Verantwortung übernehmen und Lust haben, gemeinsam etwas Sinnvolles zu bewegen.

Willkommen bei Kufer – Software für Bildung. Lösung für Menschen.

DevOps Engineer (m/w/d)

Wir bauen unsere Plattform gerade neu auf – weg von On-Premises, hin zu einer modernen, Kubernetes-basierten SaaS-Infrastruktur. Keine „wir machen schon immer Kubernetes“-Rolle, sondern die Chance, aktiv mitzugestalten, mit kurzen Wegen und echter Verantwortung.

Als DevOps Engineer (m/w/d) verantwortest du den stabilen, sicheren Betrieb unserer Kubernetes-Infrastruktur in Cloud und On-Premises, automatisierst die Deployment-Strecke gemeinsam mit unseren Entwicklungsteams und treibst voran, wie KI-Agenten sinnvoll in unsere Betriebsprozesse einfließen.

Was dich an Aufgaben erwartet:

  • Betrieb, Wartung und Weiterentwicklung unserer Kubernetes-basierten Infrastruktur (SaaS und On-Premises) sowie Aufbau und Pflege von CI/CD-Pipelines (z. B. Azure DevOps)
  • Mitgestaltung agentischer Automatisierung: KI-Agenten sinnvoll in Deployment- und Betriebsprozesse einbinden, statt jeden Handgriff manuell zu wiederholen
  • Unterstützung der .NET-Teams im Produktbetrieb (Deployment, Monitoring, Release- und Rollout-Themen)
  • Troubleshooting und Monitoring über Infrastruktur-, Netzwerk- und Applikationsebene hinweg zur Sicherstellung von Verfügbarkeit und Stabilität
  • Mitgestaltung von Security-Maßnahmen im Betrieb (z. B. Secrets Management, Zugriffskontrolle, Netzwerkpolicies) sowie stabile Datenbank- und Storage-Anbindungen (z. B. PostgreSQL)
  • Erstellung und Pflege technischer Dokumentation für Infrastruktur, Deployments und Betriebsprozesse


Was du mitbringen solltest:

  • Abgeschlossenes Studium in der Informatik oder eine vergleichbare Aus- bzw. Weiterbildung
  • Fundierte Praxiserfahrung im DevOps- oder Platform-Umfeld

jobs.title: TUM Project Study: Earned LinkedIn Media for Enterprise
jobs.description:
About us

Mediacharge GmbH is a Munich-based, internationally oriented marketing agency with ten years of experience in cutting-edge marketing for international enterprises. Operating in 14 languages, we combine first-tier strategic consulting with hands-on operational excellence, measured against business results.

Project description (TUM Project)

This project study explores what turns an enterprise’s own people into LinkedIn voices that measurably drive Sales, Recruiting or Employer Brand. Using Mediacharge and its enterprise clients as the case environment, it examines how earned media, meaning content published by real people rather than paid brand channels, creates business impact.

The project combines a business strategy perspective - objectives, the right people and measurable outcomes - with a content and platform perspective, focusing on talent profiles, content types, success patterns and the time it takes to build an effective voice.

Objectives of the project study

  • to classify enterprise objectives for earned LinkedIn media (Sales, Recruiting, Employer Brand),

  • to identify which talent profiles and content types work best for each objective,

  • to derive success patterns, including what it takes and how long it takes to see results,

  • to develop one strategy blueprint per objective and an impact model to measure business effect.

Main task and methodology

Students explore the topic through research, interviews and real enterprise cases (month 1), classify goals, talent profiles and success patterns (month 2), and build strategy blueprints, a final report and a pitch to Mediacharge leadership (month 3). Recommended methods include desk research, expert interviews, enterprise case analysis, benchmarking and impact modelling.

Student requirements

Students are fascinated by marketing at international enterprise scale, work analytically and build things that hold up in practice. Strong results open the door to a next conversation with Mediacharge.

Project scope and application

Preferred scope: 3 months in three phases: Explore, Analyse, Build

Number of students: 3–5

Supervision: A Mediacharge supervisor with direct input from enterprise practice; final pitch to leadership

Client access: Mediacharge enterprise clients, on request and case by case

Research budget: €2,000, released for a defined purpose agreed with the supervisor

jobs.title: Product Line Manager
jobs.description:
About Wallee Group AG

Wallee Group is a leader in advanced payment solutions, dedicated to providing robust, scalable, and secure systems across multiple domains. We enhance customer experiences through innovative payment and finance technology that empowers businesses to grow efficiently. With operations spanning several countries, we thrive on collaboration and agility, utilizing the Scrum framework to drive our international teams. At Wallee, we stay at the forefront of market trends, continuously innovating to deliver premier services to our global customers.

The Role

The Product Line Manager owns the full lifecycle of a product line - from introduction through to controlled end-of-life. The role combines strategic portfolio and roadmap management with subject matter expertise in specific verticals, bringing market, product, and supplier perspectives into one consistent strategy.

In Wallee's payment technology context, this specifically includes managing hardware/firmware generations (e.g., terminal models, certification versions like the EMV L2 kernel) and forward-looking planning for successor products.

The Impact You’ll Make

  • Drive Full Lifecycle & Strategy: Own the product journey from concept to decommissioning—defining launch criteria, target segments, success metrics, and forward-looking successor products before hardware/firmware generation changes.

  • Optimize the Portfolio: Maintain a structured view of all variants (terminal types, SoftPOS vs. hardware POS) using frameworks like the BCG matrix to prioritize investment and avoid overlap/cannibalization.

  • Build Capacity-Synced Roadmaps: Translate strategic goals and vertical needs into prioritized, time-boxed feature roadmaps (e.g., quarterly or PI planning in SAFe), balancing "run the business" compliance updates against "grow the business" initiatives.

  • Champion Vertical Expertise & Research: Act as the "translator" between vertical requirements (e.g., retail, hospitality, events) and engineering's technical language while running ongoing trend scanning (PCI/EMV updates), competitor analysis, and customer feedback synthesis.

  • Lead Go-to-Market & Sales Enablement: Define launch plans (positioning, pricing, training, documentation), coordinate alignment across Sales, Marketing, and Support, and assist Sales with technical expertise on complex, regulated deals.

  • Manage Suppliers & Ecosystems: Onboard and manage external partners (terminal manufacturers, component suppliers, certification labs), overseeing SLAs, operational forecasting, defect escalations, contract negotiations, and risk mitigation (such as dual-sourcing).

What Success Looks Like

  • Strategic Portfolio Health: A clear, non-overlapping product line where investments are prioritized effectively and End-of-Sale (EOS) / End-of-Life (EOL) migration paths are seamlessly executed.

  • Uncompromising Compliance: Continuous alignment with certification and regulatory standards (PCI, EMV, ep2) across the entire portfolio, eliminating compliance risk.

  • Reliable Supplier Alignment: High-performing partner relationships with well-managed SLAs, aligned roadmaps, and secure supply chains.

  • Market-Driven Innovation: Roadmaps and GTM materials that accurately reflect vertical user journeys, market trends, and validated customer needs.

  • Cross-Functional Readiness: Seamless coordination with internal teams so all departments are aligned and fully enabled from day one of product launches.

What You Bring to the Table

  • Product Experience: Proven experience in product management, ideally with portfolio or product line ownership in fintech, payments, or hardware-enabled software.

  • Domain Knowledge: Understanding or familiarity with payment certification and compliance topics (PCI, EMV, ep2) is a strong plus.

  • Vertical & Market Expertise: Experience or strong interest in specific industry verticals, coupled with a track record in market research and competitor analysis.

  • Strategic & Analytical Mindset: Strong problem-solving skills with a solution- and customer-oriented approach.

  • Stakeholder & Supplier Management: Exceptional communication and negotiation skills, comfortable managing both internal stakeholders and external supplier relationships.

  • Languages: Fluent in English and German.

Why Join Wallee?

  • Modern Workspace: A beautiful office in the heart of Winterthur - comfortable, bright, and collaboration-ready.

  • True Flexibility: Flexible daily hours and a 4-week "Work from Anywhere" policy every year.

  • Innovation First: We work with the latest tech stacks in a flat hierarchy where your voice actually matters.

  • Growth & Culture: Competitive compensation, aligned with experience, seniority, and expertise, personal development budgets, and a social calendar filled with events.

  • The Perks: Fresh fruits, snacks, and high-quality coffee to keep you fueled.

Don’t tick every box? Neither do most great hires. If the role feels right, reach out, we’d love to see if we’re a match.

jobs.title: CENTRALE LYON - Doctorat Modélisation prédictive de matériaux polymères recyclés par inférence statistique et apprentissage machine hybride.
jobs.description:
Contexte

Le projet MIAM, soutenu par l’Institut Carnot Ingénierie@Lyon, propose une thèse de doctorat de 36 mois au sein du Laboratoire de Tribologie et Dynamique des Systèmes (LTDS UMR CNRS 5513, Ecole Centrale de Lyon, Ecully, France). Ce travail de recherche s’inscrit dans une collaboration étroite entre les équipes DySCo du LTDS et les laboratoires partenaires comme le LAMCOS (INSA de Lyon) et du Centre Technique Industriel (CTI) de la Plasturgie et des Composites français (IPC). L’objectif scientifique est de lever les verrous liés à la variabilité des matières plastiques recyclées en développant des stratégies d’apprentissage machine et d’inférence statistique capables de garantir une qualité de 1 production stable malgré l’hétérogénéité des gisements de matériaux.

Le cœur des travaux portera sur le développement d’une structure d’apprentissage originale permettant de fusionner des données expérimentales réelles avec des données synthétiques issues de simulations numériques. Le candidat devra concevoir des modèles prédictifs robustes, souvent qualifiés de jumeaux numériques, pour assurer un pilotage des procédés en temps réel. Cette approche vise à réduire drastiquement les délais de mise en œuvre de nouveaux matériaux innovants tout en maintenant une fidélité physique stricte, assurant ainsi que les modèles ne soient pas de simples corrélations statistiques mais reflètent la réalité mécanique.

Cas d’étude

Le cas d’application principal retenu pour cette recherche est le développement d’un capteur virtuel appliqué à la rhéologie au sein des lignes de transformation de l’IPC. En instrumentant les étapes de mélange et d’injection, le doctorant cherchera à prédire les propriétés finales de la matière, telles que la viscosité et le comportement des granulés, en fonction des réglages machines. Ce cas offre un terrain d’étude idéal pour tester la résilience des algorithmes face à des conditions de production changeantes.


Profil recherché

Le profil recherché pour cette thèse est celui d’un candidat possédant une double compétence affirmée en intelligence artificielle et en modélisation physique des matériaux. Une maîtrise des outils de programmation et une sensibilité aux problématiques industrielles sont indispensables pour mener à bien les missions de ce projet. Les travaux se dérouleront principalement à l’École Centrale de Lyon, avec des échanges réguliers entre les sites d’Écully, de Villeurbanne et d’Oyonnax, et bénéficieront d’un environnement scientifique de haut niveau dédié à l’innovation dans le domaine des matériaux et des procédés.

Type de contrat

Le contrat sera un CDD de type contrat doctoral ’avec activité (diffusion d’informations scientifiques et/ou expertise)’ géré par Centrale Lyon. La rémunération sera d’approximativement 2035€ net par mois sur 36 mois.

jobs.description:
The essentials

Team: Product & Engineering

Start date: As soon as possible

Location: Berlin — hybrid, 3 days in the office

Working language: English (German: a plus)

Salary band: Shared before your first interview

Your impact

As (Senior) Backend Engineer at Gymondo, you build and improve the scalable backend systems that power our platform for hundreds of thousands of active users. You work with a modern tech stack, establish new services using clean architecture principles, and help translate legacy concepts into maintainable, future-proof code. Your work directly shapes the technical foundation that enables Gymondo to grow — reliably, efficiently and at scale.

What you’ll drive

  • You build, improve and maintain scalable backend services using Golang and Gin-Gonic, following clean architecture and established design patterns

  • You design and implement REST APIs following OpenAPI standards, with a focus on clarity, reliability and long-term maintainability

  • You contribute to our microservice architecture — working on reliability, scaling, stateless applications and event-driven systems

  • You rebuild legacy concepts and translate them into well-known programming patterns with transparent and maintainable business logic

  • You develop data-driven features and are involved in all stages of the development process — from design to deployment

  • You work on our scalable, automated infrastructure using AWS, Kubernetes and Terraform

  • You participate in peer code reviews, write unit tests and champion agile development practices

  • You share knowledge, discuss better solutions openly and grow together with the team

What defines you

Must-have

  • 4+ years of professional experience in backend-focused development, including infrastructure

  • 3+ years contributing to microservice architectures with a focus on reliability, scaling, stateless applications, event-driven systems and clean architecture

  • 3+ years designing REST APIs following OpenAPI standards

  • Proven hands-on experience with Golang and Gin-Gonic

  • Ability to design proof of concepts and prototypes

  • Standardised coding practices: peer code reviews, unit testing and a preference for agile development

  • An open mindset and genuine interest in state-of-the-art technologies and methodologies

  • Fluent English

Nice-to-have

jobs.title: TYPO3 Developer
jobs.description:
TYPO3 Developer
(Mensch)

Andere zählen Schafe. Du zählst TYPO3-Major-Versionen, die du schon migriert hast. Und hast Lust, die Websites großer, internationaler Unternehmen technisch zu verantworten?

Zur Übersicht

Der ultimative TYPO3-Check

Du bist bei uns richtig, wenn du…

  • … bei „Wir brauchen nur ein kleines Feld mehr im Backend“ im Kopf schon TCA, Datenbank-Migration und die drei Fluid-Templates aufklappst, die es wirklich braucht.

  • … für dein wichtigstes Werkzeug hältst. Direkt nach dem Cache-Leeren.

  • … beim Satz „Das ging in TYPO3 v7 aber noch“ freundlich lächelst und den Extension Scanner startest.

  • … sofort merkst, wenn dir die KI eine TypoScript-Lösung aus dem Jahr 2014 andreht. Und sie trotzdem jeden Tag nutzt, weil sie dich schneller macht.

  • … und dein Gewissen dir verbietet, freitags um 16 Uhr ein Major-Update auf Production zu schieben. Auch nicht „nur schnell“.

… dann gilt für uns nur noch eins: composer require netfed/du

Worum geht es?

Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Technik großer Corporate-Websites. Von der Aufwandsschätzung über Konzeption und Neuaufbau bis zu Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates. Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden und sorgst dafür, dass unsere Projekte auf einem sauberen technischen Fundament stehen.

Warum diese Rolle bei uns anders ist?

Wir arbeiten für namhafte Konzerne und große Mittelständler, bei denen die Website ein strategisches Aushängeschild ist. Du baust hier nicht Website Nummer 47 nach Schema F. Du triffst die technischen Entscheidungen und verantwortest die Architektur. Dabei vertrauen wir voll auf deine Erfahrung. Dazu kommen eine eigene, von uns betriebene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung und eine gelebte DevOps-Kultur, die sich am Stand der Technik orientiert.

Und was ist mit KI?

Gehört bei uns zum Alltag. Nicht als Pilotprojekt, sondern als Werkzeug. Du arbeitest mit KI als Sparringspartner: beim Refactoring, beim Testen, beim Dokumentieren, beim schnellen Zweitblick auf eine Migration. Die KI schlägt vor, du entscheidest. Genau deshalb suchen wir jemanden mit echter TYPO3-Erfahrung, der erkennt, wann ein Vorschlag gut ist und wann er Unsinn ist.

Was sind deine Aufgaben?

  • Du erstellst die technische Konzeption neu aufzubauender TYPO3-Websites.

  • Du verantwortest die TYPO3-Aspekte großer Kundenprojekte: Aufwandsschätzung, Neuaufbau, Weiterentwicklung, Support und Updates.

  • Du setzt KI-Tools im Entwickleralltag ein und bringst unseren KI-Einsatz in der Entwicklung weiter voran.

  • Du dokumentierst so, dass andere weiterarbeiten können. Auch dein zukünftiges Ich.

Beratung und Support

  • Du berätst Kolleg:innen und Kunden bei technischen Themen, zum Beispiel bei der Wahl der CMS-Architektur.

  • Du bearbeitest Kunden-Tickets und Support-Anfragen, die unser First-Level-Support nicht direkt lösen kann.

  • Du übersetzt Technik in Kunden-Deutsch und Kundenwünsche in saubere Technik.

Was bringst du mit?

  • 4 bis 8 Jahre Erfahrung mit der Umsetzung anspruchsvoller Websites auf Basis von TYPO3.

  • Du kennst dich mit den umgebenden Tools und Technologien aus, zum Beispiel Composer, JSON, JavaScript und XML.

  • Du beherrschst den Umgang mit SQL-Datenbanken, zum Beispiel MariaDB.

  • Du arbeitest mit KI-Coding-Tools und weißt, wo sie helfen und wo nicht.

  • Du arbeitest gern agil mit Jira, Confluence und GitLab.

Wäre gut,
aber kein Muss

  • Erfahrung mit WordPress.

  • Erfahrung mit Solr oder Elasticsearch.

  • Praxis mit Docker, Kubernetes und DevOps-Methoden.

Rahmenbedingungen

  • Werkzeuge: Jira, Confluence, GitLab, Office 365, Docker, Kubernetes

  • Infrastruktur: Eigene Cloud-Hosting-Umgebung mit technologischem Freiraum, in der Entwicklung und im Live-Betrieb

  • Starkes Netzwerk: Als Teil der team neusta Gruppe hast du kurze Wege zu über 800 Expert:innen, wenn dein Projekt zusätzliche Spezialpower braucht.

  • Zeitraum: ab sofort

Interesse?

Wir verzichten auf klassische Anschreiben.

Schick uns einfach deinen Lebenslauf und gerne 2 bis 3 kurze Beispiele aus deinen TYPO3-Projekten: TYPO3-Version, Umfang des Projekts, deine Rolle, größte technische Herausforderung.

Und ein Satz dazu, wie du KI beim Entwickeln einsetzt, hilft uns sehr.

Teilst du uns dabei auch deinen Gehaltswunsch und deinen frühestmöglichen Eintrittstermin mit? Das wäre prima.

Nutzen Sie den Button auf dieser Seite für Ihre Bewerbung.

Unser Team, deine Vorteile

Wir bei NetFed sind davon überzeugt, dass es ein gutes Arbeitsklima und gegenseitige Wertschätzung benötigt, um produktiv arbeiten zu können. Unsere Erfolgsformel für NetFed-Wachstum heißt deshalb: Wir schaffen gemeinsam mit unseren Mitarbeiter:innen ein optimales Arbeitsumfeld, das Spaß und Leidenschaft bei der Arbeit ermöglicht und gleichzeitig genügend Spielraum für das Privatleben lässt.

jobs.title: Trainee Marketing, Analytics & AI
jobs.description:

💚 About us

Our mission is to help marketing teams unlock their full growth potential with AI. Most companies still judge their marketing by last-click. Our AI-powered attribution shows which channels actually drive revenue, and our platform automatically moves ad budgets to where they have the most impact. As a Zurich-based AI scale-up of around 30 people, we support leading European brands in e-commerce, telecommunications, banking, insurance and energy.

🚀 Your mission

Get future-proof. In our 12-month traineeship you learn, at the intersection of marketing, analytics and AI, how modern marketing is measured and optimized with algorithms. You will have a dedicated expert buddy to show you the ropes. You won't learn how AI replaces your job, but how to work with it and achieve more. After one year, you look after your own clients and move into a permanent role in our Customer Success & Account Management team.

🗺️ Your year at Nexoya

  • Foundations (Months 1 to 3): You learn how digital advertising works, from search to social to display, using Google, Meta, TikTok and Snapchat as examples. Then you dive into analytics and attribution, understand how our algorithms optimize budgets, and get your personal AI toolkit.

  • Applied (Months 4 to 8): Together with your buddy you look after your first clients and lead your first calls yourself. You also spend time in marketing, sales and product, and join a sprint with our Founder & CEO.

  • Ownership (Months 9 to 12): You look after clients fully on your own and take responsibility for your own projects.

🧑‍💻 Your tasks

  • Analyze cross-channel performance data (Google Ads, Meta, TikTok, Snap, etc.)

  • Master attribution, marketing mix modeling and incrementality, and explain them clearly to our clients

  • Prepare, interpret and present the budget optimizations from our platform

  • Work with AI tools every day for analysis, reporting and client meeting preparation

  • Understand what a client really needs, challenge assumptions with data and turn insights into clear recommendations, in German and English

  • Own projects that move our team and our platform forward

🎯 What you bring

  • You are at the start of your career, eager, like taking responsibility and want to learn fast

  • Enthusiasm for AI and analytics: you don't need to be a developer, but you should want to work with AI every day

  • A completed or soon-to-be-completed degree in business, data science, marketing or a related field

  • Enjoy working with numbers and data, for example in Excel or Google Sheets

  • Fluent in German and English is a must, Italian is a plus

  • A plus: your own AI projects, an internship in performance marketing, first experience with Claude, SQL, Python or BI tools

Why Nexoya?

✨ Future-proof skills: AI, marketing and analytics in one program

✨ A clear plan with fixed milestones, a personal buddy and regular development talks. You also start together with a second trainee

✨ A permanent contract from day one, plus a fixed salary increase and equity in Nexoya (ESOP) once you complete the traineeship

✨ A personal learning budget, for example for Google Ads or Meta certifications

✨ A real AI-first culture. Experiment, automate and share what you build, and work with MCPs, coworkers and agents

✨ A team you’ll love working with, an office just a few minutes’ walk from Zurich main station and the flexibility to work from home 3 days/week

jobs.title: Senior Fraud & Risk Analyst (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Your Mission

This is a company built for growth.

When you join exmox, you're stepping onto a global, highly competitive playing field, solving real problems in environments that push you beyond your comfort zone. We move fast, cut the noise, and focus on what actually matters, because in our industry, speed wins.

With 50M+ platform downloads, we’re rapidly scaling one of the most exciting innovations in mobile gaming: a rewarded user engagement and acquisition platform that helps players discover, and engage with games they enjoy - creating lasting value for both players and gaming studios.

As a Senior Fraud Analyst, you'll join our Fraud Analytics team as a close partner to our Fraud Analytics Team Lead - someone who can operate independently, mentor other team members, and help shape the fraud and risk agenda as the team and company scale.

You'll work cross-functionally with different teams, dig into fraud patterns across our platform, and build the processes we don't have yet. It's a highly visible, high-ownership role in a fast-growing company.

What You'll Own:

  • Strategic partnership: Partner directly with the Fraud Analytics Team Lead on strategy, ideation, and day-to-day problem solving - acting as a sounding board, ready to step in and keep things moving when needed.
  • Reporting uplift: Drive the evolution of fraud and risk reporting, turning raw data into sharp, decision-ready insights.
  • Fraud trend analysis: Hunt down patterns across our user base, shape the detection logic and rules that keep us ahead of bad actors, monitor how those rules perform, and optimise them over time.
  • Process ownership: Own the design of fraud and risk processes end-to-end, spotting gaps and building what doesn't exist yet.
  • Experimentation: Test, learn, and iterate - running A/B tests to continuously sharpen our fraud prevention strategies.
  • Strategic thinking: Think beyond the day-to-day, helping define where fraud and risk management goes next as the team scales.
  • Mentorship & collaboration: Mentor teammates and partner cross-functionally with Tech, Data, Product, Support, and Finance - becoming a go-to person others rely on.

What You Bring

  • Fraud & risk experience: 5+ years in fraud, risk management, or a closely related financial risk function; direct fraud experience is a strong plus, ideally in gaming or another B2C/app-based industry.
  • Data & AI fluency: Comfort working with data - SQL, databases, and hands-on experience using AI tools for analysis and prompting.
  • Analytical mindset: Strong analytical skills and genuine comfort with numbers, paired with the ability to turn analysis into clear, actionable reporting.
  • Strategic contribution: Experience contributing to or developing risk/fraud strategy, not just executing existing processes — including running A/B tests to validate ideas.
  • Collaboration & mentorship: Experience mentoring or supporting colleagues, and working cross-functionally across different stakeholder perspectives.
  • Education: A relevant Bachelor's or Master's degree (Business, Finance, Accounting, Data/Mathematics, Engineering, or similar).
  • Language: Fluent English, written and spoken.

Nice to have:

  • Background in policy design or risk governance frameworks.
  • Relevant certifications such as CFE, CFCS, CAMS, CRISC, CFA, and/or FRM.
  • Working knowledge of relevant regulatory frameworks - e.g. GDPR, PSD2/SCA, AML/KYC principles, and PCI-DSS basics where payment data is processed.

How We Win

  • Speed is the feature. Speed beats rocket science. We move fast, test fast, and multiply our pace with AI, because action creates information and small wins compound. A fast failure is a lesson we learn from, a slow one is a problem we can't afford.
  • Focus on the essential. Done is better than perfect. We stay focused on what actually moves us forward and protect people's time from anything that doesn't. We're direct in how we communicate too, no rambling, no unnecessary detail.
  • See it. Own it. Solve it. The first to see it is best placed to fix it. We're not a place for comfort, we're a place for doers. "Not my job" isn't in our vocabulary, if you spot something, you help make sure it gets solved.
  • Respect others. Trust multiplies. Respect is non-negotiable. We disagree with ideas, never with people. Trust here is built the same way it is anywhere, through consistency, a thank you, a moment of listening, and owning your mistakes.
  • Perks that help you focus on what matters. Transport subsidy, learning budget, wellness and gym, workation, bi-weekly team lunches, and more. The perks are great, but the real reason people join and stay is the challenge, the ownership, and the drive to win together.

Please note: this is not a remote only position, we offer you a flexible hybrid model here in Hamburg, Germany - working from home on Mondays & Fridays, coming to the office on Tuesday, Wednesday & Thursday!

jobs.title: Product Engineer (f/m/x)
jobs.description:
Cologne, Germany (Hybrid)

Team: Product & Engineering · Reports to: CTO · Format: Full-time, permanent

Own a piece of the product, not a ticket queue

ilert is the alerting, on-call and incident response platform that engineering teams worldwide rely on when things break. That covers alerting, on-call scheduling, call routing, status pages, and an AI SRE that investigates incidents alongside the people responding to them.

We're bootstrapped, profitable, and small (~15 engineers). Your work reaches customers fast, and you have a real say in what gets built.

We're looking for a Product Engineer to own one area of that product. We'll give you a domain, not a spec. You figure out what customers need, build it across the stack, ship it, and check whether it made a difference.

We build with AI every day. But AI is leverage on top of engineering, not a substitute for it. We're looking for a solid engineer first, someone who uses AI to move faster, not to skip understanding the code.

Tasks

  • Own a product domain end-to-end. Depending on where you'll have the most impact, that could be alerting, on-call and call routing, status pages, integrations, or our AI SRE. You propose what to build, build it, and measure whether it worked.
  • Ship across the stack. Java and Rust on the backend, React and TypeScript on the frontend. We work in 2-week bets that end in a production deploy.
  • Talk to customers. Join customer calls, read support conversations, dig into usage data, and turn what you learn into product improvements.
  • Make the scope calls. Decide what to cut, what ships first, and what to validate before building it. We trust you with these trade-offs.
  • Own it in production. You're responsible for what you ship, including when it breaks. Reliability is literally our product.

What you bring

  • 2+ years of software engineering in a team codebase. That means code review, tests, production incidents, and code you didn't write alone. Side projects are great, but they don't replace this.
  • You've shipped features end-to-end and cared whether people actually used them.
  • Comfortable across the stack. Strong on one side, and willing and able to work on the other.
  • Solid fundamentals. Data modeling, debugging, testing, and thinking through failure modes. You can read unfamiliar code and reason about it before you reach for a prompt.
  • Real AI fluency. You use AI coding tools every day, you know where they help and where they mislead, and you can defend a design decision without "the AI suggested it."
  • Product instinct. You have opinions about what to build, not just how.
  • Comfortable with ambiguity. A domain and a problem are enough for you to get going.
  • Fluent English (our working language).
  • Able to be in our Cologne office 3 days a week.

Bonus

  • Experience at a B2B SaaS or developer-tools company

jobs.description:
Why join us?

Mitti by SafetyCulture is a global tech company, just not the kind you're picturing. Our almost 1,000-person team builds tools that make work better for the three billion frontline workers who keep the world moving. We've got big tech scale, without the sign-off layers or corporate theatre. This next chapter is about scaling smart, powered by AI, a clear vision and real ownership.

Big tech impact, without the big tech ick.

Role Purpose

This role exists to unlock technical value for Mitti’s customers, designing and implementing solutions that ensure customers integrate deeply with the platform and realise measurable operational outcomes, while bridging the gap between Go-to-Market (GTM) teams and Product, Design & Engineering (PDE). They own end-to-end delivery of integration offerings within defined scope, timeline, and budget, escalating only where customer requirements exceed standard package boundaries.

 

Key Responsibilities

Drive customer success and stickiness

  • Own technical solution design for select customers: from scoping integrations and data workflows through to working implementations that enable full platform value.

  • Deliver the standard Integration/Automation packages end-to-end: scope confirmation, project delivery, build, testing, and handoff within the defined timeline and effort budget.

  • Advise customers and partners on integration architecture: how to connect Mitti to their existing systems effectively and sustainably.

  • Partner with Customer Success Managers (CSMs) to build implementation plans that accelerate time-to-value for managed accounts.

  • Work alongside Account Executives (AEs) during pre-sales to communicate technical platform capabilities (APIs, security architecture, and cloud integrations) and resolve technical blockers in the sales cycle.

  • Act as a technical bridge between GTM and PDE, capturing and routing customer integration feedback that shapes the product roadmap.

  • Partner with the API and Integrations Engineering team to resolve complex customer requirements and advocate for platform improvements that benefit the broader customer base.

 

Improve how we deliver

  • Identify recurring technical patterns across customer integrations, propose and participate in standardisation efforts: new packaged offerings, reusable automation, or templated solutions that reduce delivery effort across the customer base, not just for one account.

  • Build and maintain technical automations (scripts, workflows, tooling) that reduce manual effort in the standard delivery motion, contributing them back to the shared Customer Solution & Implementation toolkit rather than keeping them account-specific.

  • Flag when the same "out of scope" request appears repeatedly across customers, as a signal the package boundary itself needs to move, not just that this customer needs an exception.

 

Required Skills & Experience

Technical Skills

  • Proven ability to design and implement data solutions: writing SQL queries, modelling relational databases, and translating raw data into business-relevant insights.

  • Comfortable building across scripting or programming languages (e.g. Python, JavaScript, Ruby, Golang) to automate workflows or extend platform capabilities for specific customer use cases.

  • Able to navigate a wide variety of enterprise system architectures, data models, and integration patterns.

  • Confident reading API documentation and building or troubleshooting API integrations in enterprise environments.

  • Background spanning software development and data analytics; comfortable moving between building solutions and communicating data-driven insights to non-technical stakeholders.

Behavioural Skills

  • Translates fluently between technical and non-technical audiences: equally credible in an engineering deep-dive and a customer-facing session with business stakeholders.

  • Stays organised across a high-volume, concurrent workload; switches context quickly without losing quality or missing detail.

  • Customer-first problem solver: listens to understand the real need before proposing a solution, and brings options rather than just problems.

  • Self-directed and comfortable with ambiguity; exercises sound judgment on edge cases while operating within a defined delivery methodology.

  • Team-first mindset: invests in the success of CSMs, AEs, and engineering partners, not just their own outcomes.

  • Distinguishes clearly between solving a customer's immediate problem and identifying a systemic delivery improvement worth productising, and routes each appropriately.

AI Skills

  • Uses AI tools to accelerate integration work, drafting technical specs and documentation, analysing customer data to surface insights, and building automations faster.

  • Applies AI coding assistants fluently in day-to-day work; evaluates AI-generated code for quality, correctness, and security before deploying.

  • Proficient with AI tools: independently identifies where AI adds leverage in their workflows and adopts new capabilities without direction.

 

Benefits

At Mitti, we care about people and growing the team, through:

  • Equity with high growth potential, and a competitive salary,

  • Hybrid working arrangements with flexibility,

  • Access to professional and personal training and development opportunities; Hackathons, Workshops, Lunch & Learns;

  • We encourage involvement in the community, open source work, attending talks and events, and experimenting with new technologies.

You'll also receive other perks such as:

  • Remote flexible working arrangements

  • Wellbeing initiatives such as subsidised fitness programs, EAP services and generous parental leave policy

  • Quarterly celebrations and team events

  • Table tennis, board games, gym sessions, book club, and pet-friendly offices.

We’re committed to building inclusive teams and cultivating a sense of belonging so our people can bring their whole authentic selves to work each day. We seek to make reasonable adjustments throughout our recruitment process to create an even playing field for all candidates. Thanks to the tireless efforts of the entire Mitti team we’ve built an incredible culture which has seen us recognised as a Best Place to Work in Australia , the US and the UK .

jobs.title: Senior DevSecOps Engineer
jobs.description:
Who are we?

Smarkets: Predicting the Future of Betting

Smarkets is a prediction market exchange for sports and political trading, having handled over $50 billion in volume since 2010. We're upending sports betting with the fairest prices, the best technology, and a superior customer experience, powered by attracting great people and building a high-performance environment where they thrive. We're looking for an atypical candidate with strong regulated-business experience to support our growing CFTC business.

The Team

Security sits within Infrastructure and Engineering, protecting the distributed, real-time systems behind our trading engine. The team's remit spans our core products and our DCM/DCO entities, with a real regulatory dimension to the work, particularly around our CFTC-regulated business units. Alongside that regulatory scope, the focus is squarely on hands-on engineering: designing, building, and shipping the security tooling and controls that let engineering teams move fast safely.

About the Role:

This is a founding build. You'll stand up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and mature it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams to build the controls, automation, and guardrails our trading systems and regulated entities need.

What you will do:

  • Build the Foundations: Be part of a founding build, standing up security engineering from the ground up through go-live and maturing it as we scale, working within Infrastructure and Engineering teams.

  • Design Guardrails: Design, build, and deploy security controls and guardrails across cloud-native platforms, including AI security solutions protecting customer-facing and internal products.

  • Automate as Code: Automate security processes as code, embedding compliance and infrastructure-as-code checks into CI/CD pipelines without slowing down frequent shipping.

  • Assess & Remediate: Conduct risk audits and assessments, translating findings into practical recommendations for engineering teams, and be hands-on in implementing those recommendations.

  • Monitor & Respond: Monitor and analyse system access logs, flag anomalies, and support incident response, containment, and post-incident root cause analysis.

  • Plan for Resilience: Plan and test security backups and disaster recovery processes to keep the platform resilient.

  • Maintain Compliance: Develop and maintain security policies, standards, and controls meeting DCM/DCO requirements, and maintain evidence and documentation to support regulatory examinations and audits.

  • Partner Across Teams: Partner with business and engineering teams on solutions, translating technical work for product and engineering audiences.

  • Champion Ownership: Build a culture of security ownership among engineers, acting as a security partner rather than a gatekeeper.

Role Requirements:

  • Security Engineering Background: Hands-on experience building security engineering/DevSecOps capabilities in a cloud-native, high-growth environment, ideally financial services or exchange infrastructure.

  • Confident Communicator: Comfortable communicating security risk, controls and technical decisions verbally and in writing to external stakeholders such as auditors or regulators.

  • Regulatory Familiarity: Familiarity with CFTC system safeguards expectations, including 17 C.F.R. § 38.1051 and § 39.18 or similar regulatory requirements.

  • AppSec Foundations: Strong grasp of application security principles (OWASP Top 10, NIST) and secure SDLC practices.

  • CI/CD & Tooling: Proficiency with CI/CD tooling (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, Jenkins, Azure DevOps, CircleCI) and security tools (Snyk, Aqua, Trivy, Checkov, Twistlock, Clair).

  • Cloud & Container Security: Hands-on expertise securing AWS/Azure/GCP, Kubernetes, containers, and IaC.

  • Compliance as Code: Working knowledge of infrastructure-as-code and compliance-as-code practices.

  • Automation Proficiency: Proficiency in at least one of Python, Bash, or Go, with a track record of automating security processes.

  • Nice-to-have: Demonstrated experience deploying AI security solutions, guardrails, and defences for AI systems used by customers; a personal interest in sports, exchanges, or trading; certifications such as DSOP, CKS, CISSP, CCSP, CSSLP, or an AWS/Azure/GCP Security Specialty; a track record of security automation at scale in Agile/Scrum environments; direct experience with regulators/examiners on technology and system safeguards; and familiarity with event contracts, prediction markets, or similar novel futures products under CFTC.

Our Values

Our values are at the heart of everything we do, guiding how we work, collaborate, and innovate. They reflect what we expect of ourselves and each other to deliver the best results, while fostering a positive, high-performing environment:

  • Push to Win: We set ambitious goals and relentlessly pursue them, always striving for excellence.

  • Make Others Better: We lift each other up, share knowledge, and celebrate team success over individual achievement.

  • Give a Shit: We care deeply about our work, our users, and the impact we make.

  • Be a Pro: We take ownership, act with integrity, and consistently deliver to a high standard.

  • Bring the Energy: We bring positivity, curiosity, and enthusiasm to everything we do, inspiring those around us.

Culture Fit: These values define how we succeed as a team. If this isn't you, this may not be the right place. We hire people who thrive in a fast-paced, collaborative, and ambitious environment.

Perks & Benefits

We offer a competitive salary and benefits package, alongside a dynamic, collaborative environment where your work truly makes an impact and your voice is heard. Our team is diverse, driven, and ambitious, united by a strong work ethic and a hunger to innovate and win.

Our benefits are designed around Health, Wealth, and Development, supporting you both professionally and personally. These include:

  • Stock Options: Vest over 4 years, your success is our success.

  • Pension Scheme: Competitive plan via Aviva, with up to 6% matched contributions if you opt in.

  • Health Insurance: Comprehensive coverage to keep you and your family healthy.

  • Enhanced Parental Leave: Enhanced maternity and paternity leave to support you through life's most important moments.

  • Stay Fuelled: Enjoy fresh, chef-made breakfast and lunch every day, plus a constant supply of fruit, snacks, tea, coffee and soft drinks, because great work starts with great food.

  • Cycle-to-Work Scheme: Support for sustainable commuting and staying active.

  • Learning & Development: £1,000 annual education budget for courses, conferences, books, or training.

  • Holiday: 25 days paid leave plus bank holidays, with the option to carry over 5 days.

  • Flexible Working: Hybrid model with 3 days in the office and 2 days from home to fit your lifestyle.

  • Global Working: Work from anywhere in the world for up to 20 days a year.

  • Team Energy: Regular socials, hackathons, and events, because collaboration and fun go hand-in-hand.

What happens next

  • In-Office Interview: Meet the wider team.

Diversity & Inclusion

Smarkets is an Equal Opportunity Employer, committed to equality, inclusion, and a welcoming environment for all.

As the Manager of Applied AI Architects in Paris, you will lead a team of senior technical leaders responsible for the technical strategy, customer journey, and path to production value for OpenAI's largest and most complex customers across the South EMEA region. You will serve as an executive technical sponsor for critical engagements, a senior voice of the customer inside OpenAI, and a cross-functional leader who can move confidently between regional strategy, executive decision-making, architectural depth, and hands-on coaching.

As Alan’s Corporate Paralegal, you will own the corporate governance of a fast-growing international group (six jurisdictions and a dozen entities today, more in the coming months) and rebuild how that work gets done with AI. The role has three parts:

Own Alan’s corporate governance with full ownership.

  • Prepare Boards, General Meetings and committees documentation across the group, with internal teams and auditors;

  • Run the annual accounts approval and filings for each entity, with Finance and auditors;

  • Write the playbooks, templates and guidance local teams need to follow our processes;

  • Adapt equity frameworks and documentation to new countries and local rules.

Automate the repetitive work with AI.

  • Build workflows that run in the background with light human review, using no-code tools and Alan’s internal AI, with support from our tooling team;

  • Start with recurring events such as meeting minutes, equity movements and the filings calendar.

You will join the Corporate Governance Area, led by Anne-Lise Delfanne, and work alongside a team of legal and corporate operations experts. Our collaboration model encourages growth and curiosity, so you will never feel cornered in your role.

Key outcomes after six months

  • Taken ownership of the recurring governance work for our French entities;

  • Built AI agents and workflows that take a large share of manual work off you and the team;

  • Improved our templates and documentation;

  • Reviewed or drafted legal documents in several areas;

  • Supported our international expansion, for example by opening an entity or onboarding a local team on our processes;

  • Built strong working relationships with the Corporate Governance Area, Finance, People and local advisors.

From then onwards, the role grows with you: M&A, fundraising, reorganisations and more.

Profile and competencies

Skills

This role sits at the intersection of legal knowledge, corporate operations, and AI tooling. We don't expect anyone to arrive fully skilled across all three dimensions. What matters most is your ownership mindset and genuine appetite to build. For the rest, we'll grow together.

  • Experience: Ideally 2+ years owning corporate secretarial work, as a paralegal in a law firm, in legal or corporate ops in-house, or as a company secretary.

  • Legal knowledge: a law degree or paralegal qualification, and/or hands-on experience with several of the following: board and shareholder documentation, entity management, corporate filings, equity documentation, due diligence or transaction coordination;

  • (Bonus) AI and tooling appetite: you already use no-code or AI tools (e.g. Make, Zapier, Notion automations) to save time, or you are keen to learn fast;

  • Language: excellent written and spoken English (working language at Alan) and French.

We encourage applications from career changers who do not have all the above qualifications, if you have a strong interest in working at the heart of corporate operations and willingness to learn fast.

Behavioural traits

  • Highly organised and rigorous, with exceptional attention to detail;

  • Hands-on and self-starter: not scared of getting your hands dirty;

  • Automation mindset: sees repetitive work as an opportunity to build something better, not just a task to complete;

⭐ The Product Marketing Manager B2C opportunity

Building the engagement engine with Alan Play that makes 500k members come back to their health every single day, a key differentiator for Alan.

 

Today, 25k Alan members open Alan Play every day (120,000 every month) to walk, meditate, breathe, compete with their colleagues, build healthy habits. Play is Alan's #1 source of traffic and the retention engine of all our health services. And we are B2B2C: companies pay, members choose to engage. Play is a differentiator in deals, and at renewal. HR admins are also an underused distribution channel to reach members. Two audiences, one product story. By 2030 we want 500k daily users, across all our countries

 

The challenges: Our lifecycle is greenfield. Onboarding, activation, reminders, reactivation and win-back are owned by nobody today. We run events rebuilt almost from scratch, so the tenth Alan Cup costs as much as the first. We measure opens and clicks, not what a campaign actually did to daily engagement. And on the B2B side, our pitch goes stale between releases, as Play ships fast, so the sales argument does not keep up.

 

The future: A lifecycle layer designed for personalisation, running on the segmentation and experimentation platform Play has been building. Campaign machinery that gets cheaper every quarter. A measurement loop we trust, with holdouts and real incrementality. A live Play pitch that updates as features ship, so the field walks into a renewal or a deal with the current product. And HR admins turned into a real, measured distribution channel rather than a mailing list.

 

The hard parts: This role is horizontal, and vertical. Many member segments, many admin segments, several countries, coordination with Product as well as Sales, KAM and CSM, as well as other products teams who communicate with members.

 

⭐ Is it you we’re looking for?

 

Must haves

  • Retention and lifecycle marketing at scale on a consumer product - subscription, gaming, social, media, health and fitness. Where engagement and retention are the business.

  • You build systems, not just campaigns - you can walk us through machinery you built that made the next campaign cheaper, and tell us what it cost you to get it adopted.

  • Analytical rigour - you read a funnel, design a segment, set up a holdout, call a result. You are comfortable being accountable to a product metric.

  • Horizontal operator - you have held many audiences and several countries at once. Volume and context switching, not depth on a single vertical.

  • Genuinely hands on - you want to run the campaigns yourself at the start. This is the ramp up, and the condition for standardising well afterwards.

  • Branding sensitivity : you can express the personality of the product you market and create great moments

  • You write well and fast. Emotion generating copy and branding is a real part of the job

  • Marketing automation at scale - Customer.io, Braze, Iterable or equivalent.

  • Missionary mindset and a real attachment to the health mission.

  • B2B2C sensibility: you can maintain weigh in both segments

 

Nice to haves

  • French, Spanish or Dutch on top of English, for four-country localisation

  • HR tech, employee benefits or workplace wellbeing

  • Gamification, challenges or social mechanics

  • Experience standardising something that other teams then reused

 

Not a fit if

  • You describe success in open and click rates

  • You only want to talk to members, and see commercial side as somebody else's job

  • You need a brief, or someone who writes the strategy for you

  • You want to delegate execution from day one

  • You treat positioning as PMM-only territory, or platform teams as a service desk

  • You are uncomfortable with ambiguity, or need a big team to be effective

  • Flexible vacation policy and flexible working hours. Organize your time as you wish.

  • Transport. Country-specific commuter benefits.

  • Learning & Training opportunities. A highly flexible Training policy free books and budget to attend and speak at conferences if the opportunity arises.

  • Personal growth through coaching: At Alan, coaching isn't just a perk - it's core to who we are.
